business_summary: Takamiya Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacture, sale, and rental of temporary construction equipment in Japan and internationally. It operates through Platform Business, Sales Business, Rental Business, and Overseas Business segments. It offers OPERA, a platform portal for web orders, delivery vehicle reservations, secondary market systems, and other services. The company is involved in the design, construction, management, and logistics for temporary construction work; general freight forwarding business; creation of provisional design drawings, calculation reports, and architectural equipment drawings, surveying, and various design methods including BIM/CIM modeling, and spatial measurement. It also engages in planning, design, construction, supervision, contracting, and technical guidance for architectural and civil engineering work, as well as scaffolding work; and sale of agricultural construction and agricultural materials. The company was formerly known as SRG Takamiya Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Takamiya Co., Ltd. in April 2019. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

business_summary: Takamiya Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacture, sale, and rental of temporary construction equipment in Japan and internationally. It operates through Platform Business, Sales Business, Rental Business, and Overseas Business segments. It offers OPERA, a platform portal for web orders, delivery vehicle reservations, secondary market systems, and other services. The company is involved in the design, construction, management, and logistics for temporary construction work; general freight forwarding business; creation of provisional design drawings, calculation reports, and architectural equipment drawings, surveying, and various design methods including BIM/CIM modeling, and spatial measurement. It also engages in planning, design, construction, supervision, contracting, and technical guidance for architectural and civil engineering work, as well as scaffolding work; and sale of agricultural construction and agricultural materials. The company was formerly known as SRG Takamiya Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Takamiya Co., Ltd. in April 2019. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

business_summary: All About, Inc. engages in the internet advertising business in Japan. It operates in two segments, Marketing Solutions and Consumer Services. The company is involved in the planning, sales, and posting of advertising products, as well as the provision of other corporate services. It also provides e-commerce related and membership services to general consumers in housing/real estate, finance, health/medical care, beauty, digital, lifestyle, gourmet food, travel, and health fields. In addition, the company operates social media accounts, such as Facebook navi and Twin Navi. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

business_summary: LIKE, Inc. provides human resource services in Japan. It operates through Comprehensive Human Resources Service, Child-Rearing Support Service, and Nursing Care-Related Service segments. The company offers human resource services comprising temporary staffing, outsourcing, recruitment, placement, and hiring and education support services. It also operates on-site childcare facilities, licensed nurseries, after-school clubs, and other public childcare facilities that offer outsourced and public childcare services. In addition, the company operates nursing homes that offer nursing and elderly care services. LIKE, Inc. was formerly known as J-COM Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to LIKE, Inc. in December 2016. LIKE, Inc. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Aoba-BBT, Inc. operates in the educational business in Japan. The company is involved in the distance education business; group education business; international school management; content provider business; and planning and production of business and management specialized content. It offers international schools and corporate training to universities and graduate schools (MBA). Further, the company also operates as a distance learning system consultant and service provider, an IT management business, as well as business breakthrough university management and graduate school management. In addition, it offers online English language education and communication skills training for business professionals and students, as well as video content and proprietary online learning platforms. The company was formerly known as Business Breakthrough, Inc. and changed its name to Aoba-BBT, Inc. in October 2023. Aoba-BBT, Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: S-Pool, Inc. provides business and human resources solutions in Japan. The company offers part-time and temporary employment recruitment; face-to-face member acquisition; and consulting services for calculating greenhouse gas emissions, disclosing environmental information, and carbon offset intermediation. It also provides temporary staffing; office support staffing for call centers; in-store sales support staffing for smartphones and home appliances; human resources services for the hotel industry; and field consulting services. In addition, the company offers special needs employment services, human resource outsourcing services, professional human resources utilization services, sales promotion support services, cybersecurity services, environmental management support services, decarbonization support services for local authorities, logistics outsourcing services, employment support services, wide-area administrative BPO services, business succession support services, cross-border e-commerce and marketing support services, and sales support services for municipal governments. Further, it leases farms suitable for employment for people with disabilities; and operates shared warehouses. S-Pool, Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

business_summary: S-Pool, Inc. provides business and human resources solutions in Japan. The company offers part-time and temporary employment recruitment; face-to-face member acquisition; and consulting services for calculating greenhouse gas emissions, disclosing environmental information, and carbon offset intermediation. It also provides temporary staffing; office support staffing for call centers; in-store sales support staffing for smartphones and home appliances; human resources services for the hotel industry; and field consulting services. In addition, the company offers special needs employment services, human resource outsourcing services, professional human resources utilization services, sales promotion support services, cybersecurity services, environmental management support services, decarbonization support services for local authorities, logistics outsourcing services, employment support services, wide-area administrative BPO services, business succession support services, cross-border e-commerce and marketing support services, and sales support services for municipal governments. business_summary: JTEC Corporation engages in the technical staff intellectual property leasing business for engineers in Japan and internationally. It specializes in the dispatch of engineers to the development and design departments of manufacturing companies. It also operates in human resource businesses, nursing care businesses, event businesses, and posting businesses. The group focuses on recruitment, human resource development, and sales as the main pillars of sustainable business development. It provides services in areas requiring advanced skills, such as mechanical design, electrical and electronic design, and software, and is involved in research and development and design in four fields, including architectural design. business_summary: System Location Co.,Ltd. provides business support for finance companies in Japan and internationally. The company offers solutions for auto lease, new and used car sales support, car rental, parking lot, publishing, credit, automobile maintenance, EC site, and insurance business . It also provides SYSROCKET, a SaaS solution package for auto finance businesses; CA Doctor, a sales support system for automobile dealerships; CAV Monitor, a solution that provides bulk calculation of car asset value; RV Doctor, a residual value setting system; PV Doctor, a present value calculation tool; Truck RV Doctor, a truck residual value calculator; vehicle catalog database, which consolidate database and information. The company was formerly known as Dormant Company Pine Co., Ltd. and changed its name to System Location Co.,Ltd. in July 1992. System Location Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Honyaku Center Inc. provides translation services in Japan and internationally. The company offers translation for patent documents comprising application-related, court-related, and others; and medical documents, including basic research/non-clinical development, clinical development, regulatory submission, and post-marketing. It also provides financial and legal translations comprising finance, legal, disclosure and related documents, and corporate and other documents; and translation services for IT related documents and manuals documents. In addition, the company offers translation of industrial documents, such as R&D, planning, and design documents; production, quality assurance, implementation, and maintenance service documents; sales and marketing documents; and non-manufacturing industry related documents. Further, it provides medical writing, grammar check, transcription, staffing, multilingual contact center, interpreting, foreign patent application services; proofreading and back translation, and foreign patent application services, as well as services related to computer games, apps, and Websites; and prepares drawings. Additionally, the company offers translation services for VISA application documents required to apply for marriage, work, residency, study abroad, and other visas; and DTP, printing, document, and e-book translation related services, as well as pamphlets and catalogues, press releases and newsletters, and presentation documents. The company serves clients in a range of industries, such as auto, mechanical, electronics, pharma, patent, law, finance, R&D, education, and other fields. Honyaku Center Inc. was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: JTP Co.,Ltd. provides outsourcing services to specialized technical services companies in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Digital Innovation Business, ICT Business, Life Science Business, and Other Business. The Digital Innovation Business segment provides a human resource development solution service that provides LearningBooster, a learning data utilization platform for IT engineers; security service that provides proposal and implementation of preventative security solutions to operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement activities; and DX development service that supports the promotion of DX in companies. Its ICT Business segment offers design, construction, operation and maintenance services for ICT systems. The Life Science Business segment provides maintenance services for medical equipment, chemical analyzers, etc.; consulting services for overseas medical device manufacturers; and ICT services in the life sciences field. It serves ICT manufacturers and end users. The company was formerly known as Japan Third Party Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JTP Co.,Ltd. in April 2021. JTP Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: JTP Co.,Ltd. provides outsourcing services to specialized technical services companies in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Digital Innovation Business, ICT Business, Life Science Business, and Other Business. The Digital Innovation Business segment provides a human resource development solution service that provides LearningBooster, a learning data utilization platform for IT engineers; security service that provides proposal and implementation of preventative security solutions to operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement activities; and DX development service that supports the promotion of DX in companies. Its ICT Business segment offers design, construction, operation and maintenance services for ICT systems. The Life Science Business segment provides maintenance services for medical equipment, chemical analyzers, etc.; consulting services for overseas medical device manufacturers; and ICT services in the life sciences field. It serves ICT manufacturers and end users. The company was formerly known as Japan Third Party Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JTP Co.,Ltd. in April 2021. JTP Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: JTP Co.,Ltd. provides outsourcing services to specialized technical services companies in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Digital Innovation Business, ICT Business, Life Science Business, and Other Business. The Digital Innovation Business segment provides a human resource development solution service that provides LearningBooster, a learning data utilization platform for IT engineers; security service that provides proposal and implementation of preventative security solutions to operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement activities; and DX development service that supports the promotion of DX in companies. Its ICT Business segment offers design, construction, operation and maintenance services for ICT systems. The Life Science Business segment provides maintenance services for medical equipment, chemical analyzers, etc.; consulting services for overseas medical device manufacturers; and ICT services in the life sciences field. It serves ICT manufacturers and end users. The company was formerly known as Japan Third Party Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JTP Co.,Ltd. in April 2021. JTP Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: JTP Co.,Ltd. provides outsourcing services to specialized technical services companies in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Digital Innovation Business, ICT Business, Life Science Business, and Other Business. The Digital Innovation Business segment provides a human resource development solution service that provides LearningBooster, a learning data utilization platform for IT engineers; security service that provides proposal and implementation of preventative security solutions to operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement activities; and DX development service that supports the promotion of DX in companies. Its ICT Business segment offers design, construction, operation and maintenance services for ICT systems. The Life Science Business segment provides maintenance services for medical equipment, chemical analyzers, etc.; consulting services for overseas medical device manufacturers; and ICT services in the life sciences field. It serves ICT manufacturers and end users. The company was formerly known as Japan Third Party Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JTP Co.,Ltd. in April 2021. JTP Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: Adways Inc. engages in advertisement platform, agency, and other businesses in Japan, China, Korea, Taiwan, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Thailand. It offers AppDriver and UNICORN smartphone advertising services; Smart-C mobile affiliate advertising services; and JANet affiliate advertising services; and sales and operation services of internet advertising using the group's ad platform. The company is also involved in startup investment, digital transformation business, lifestyle, and overseas businesses; and acts as an agent for the sale of advertising products and related services. Adways Inc. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

business_summary: ValueCommerce Co., Ltd. provides marketing solutions in Japan. It operates through three segments: Marketing Solutions Business, EC Solutions Business, and Travel Tech Business. The company provides performance-based advertising. It offers click-based advertising and CRM tools for online mall stores; and DYNA IBE, a hotel reservation system provided for accommodation facilities such as hotels and inns. In addition, the company provides DYNA PMS, a hotel management system; VLINK, a social commerce platform; monicam and Cast book, an influencer marketing solution; B-Space, an EC site management and support solution; and BUZMA, a subscription-based influencer matching service. The company was formerly known as Transpacific Inc. and changed its name to ValueCommerce Co., Ltd. in November 1999. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan. ValueCommerce Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Z Holdings Corporation.

business_summary: ValueCommerce Co., Ltd. provides marketing solutions in Japan. It operates through three segments: Marketing Solutions Business, EC Solutions Business, and Travel Tech Business. The company provides performance-based advertising. It offers click-based advertising and CRM tools for online mall stores; and DYNA IBE, a hotel reservation system provided for accommodation facilities such as hotels and inns. In addition, the company provides DYNA PMS, a hotel management system; VLINK, a social commerce platform; monicam and Cast book, an influencer marketing solution; B-Space, an EC site management and support solution; and BUZMA, a subscription-based influencer matching service. The company was formerly known as Transpacific Inc. and changed its name to ValueCommerce Co., Ltd. in November 1999. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan. ValueCommerce Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Z Holdings Corporation.

business_summary: ValueCommerce Co., Ltd. provides marketing solutions in Japan. It operates through three segments: Marketing Solutions Business, EC Solutions Business, and Travel Tech Business. The company provides performance-based advertising. It offers click-based advertising and CRM tools for online mall stores; and DYNA IBE, a hotel reservation system provided for accommodation facilities such as hotels and inns. In addition, the company provides DYNA PMS, a hotel management system; VLINK, a social commerce platform; monicam and Cast book, an influencer marketing solution; B-Space, an EC site management and support solution; and BUZMA, a subscription-based influencer matching service. The company was formerly known as Transpacific Inc. and changed its name to ValueCommerce Co., Ltd. in November 1999. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan. ValueCommerce Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Z Holdings Corporation.

business_summary: Infomart Corporation operates a business-to-business (BtoB) electronic commerce platform in Japan. The company operates in BtoB-PF FOOD business and BtoB-PFES business segments. The company offers BtoB Platform Invoices that digitalize both invoice receipt and issuance.; BtoB Platform Ordering for digitize everything from order placement to invoicing; BtoB platform TRADE to manage quotation, ordering, receiving, delivery, inspection, and invoicing operations digitally; BtoB Platform Ordering Lite for managing Order information from faxes, telephone calls, emails, and on the cloud; BtoB Platform Contract, a secure electronic contract service; TANOMU, a wholesale ordering system; and BP Storage for digitizing everything from invoice receipt and issuance, expense reimbursement, document storage, and carbon dioxide emission measurement. It also provides BtoB Platform Negotiations for Matching sellers, food wholesalers, restaurants, and other businesses with buyers; V-Manage to digitally manage store operations and management task; AI-OCR (invox), an AI OCR processes and digitizes faxes, emails, and PDF purchase orders; BP Workflow to digitizing internal approval and application procedures; electronic bill early payment that convert pending invoices into cash; BtoB Platform Quotation which centralized and digitized receipt and quotation; BtoB platform industry channel, an industry information portal site that streamlines sales and planning operations; Menu Plus, digitize your restaurant's menu management; Kauri Kessai, streamline processes, such as credit checks for business partners, payment collection, and payment reconciliation; BtoB platform order placement; and BtoB eSmart, a commercial food ingredients, supplies, and materials site. Infomart Corporation was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: Infomart Corporation operates a business-to-business (BtoB) electronic commerce platform in Japan. The company operates in BtoB-PF FOOD business and BtoB-PFES business segments. The company offers BtoB Platform Invoices that digitalize both invoice receipt and issuance.; BtoB Platform Ordering for digitize everything from order placement to invoicing; BtoB platform TRADE to manage quotation, ordering, receiving, delivery, inspection, and invoicing operations digitally; BtoB Platform Ordering Lite for managing Order information from faxes, telephone calls, emails, and on the cloud; BtoB Platform Contract, a secure electronic contract service; TANOMU, a wholesale ordering system; and BP Storage for digitizing everything from invoice receipt and issuance, expense reimbursement, document storage, and carbon dioxide emission measurement. It also provides BtoB Platform Negotiations for Matching sellers, food wholesalers, restaurants, and other businesses with buyers; V-Manage to digitally manage store operations and management task; AI-OCR (invox), an AI OCR processes and digitizes faxes, emails, and PDF purchase orders; BP Workflow to digitizing internal approval and application procedures; electronic bill early payment that convert pending invoices into cash; BtoB Platform Quotation which centralized and digitized receipt and quotation; BtoB platform industry channel, an industry information portal site that streamlines sales and planning operations; Menu Plus, digitize your restaurant's menu management; Kauri Kessai, streamline processes, such as credit checks for business partners, payment collection, and payment reconciliation; BtoB platform order placement; and BtoB eSmart, a commercial food ingredients, supplies, and materials site. Infomart Corporation was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: Infomart Corporation operates a business-to-business (BtoB) electronic commerce platform in Japan. The company operates in BtoB-PF FOOD business and BtoB-PFES business segments. The company offers BtoB Platform Invoices that digitalize both invoice receipt and issuance.; BtoB Platform Ordering for digitize everything from order placement to invoicing; BtoB platform TRADE to manage quotation, ordering, receiving, delivery, inspection, and invoicing operations digitally; BtoB Platform Ordering Lite for managing Order information from faxes, telephone calls, emails, and on the cloud; BtoB Platform Contract, a secure electronic contract service; TANOMU, a wholesale ordering system; and BP Storage for digitizing everything from invoice receipt and issuance, expense reimbursement, document storage, and carbon dioxide emission measurement. It also provides BtoB Platform Negotiations for Matching sellers, food wholesalers, restaurants, and other businesses with buyers; V-Manage to digitally manage store operations and management task; AI-OCR (invox), an AI OCR processes and digitizes faxes, emails, and PDF purchase orders; BP Workflow to digitizing internal approval and application procedures; electronic bill early payment that convert pending invoices into cash; BtoB Platform Quotation which centralized and digitized receipt and quotation; BtoB platform industry channel, an industry information portal site that streamlines sales and planning operations; Menu Plus, digitize your restaurant's menu management; Kauri Kessai, streamline processes, such as credit checks for business partners, payment collection, and payment reconciliation; BtoB platform order placement; and BtoB eSmart, a commercial food ingredients, supplies, and materials site. Infomart Corporation was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: E-SUPPORTLINK, Ltd. provides fresh fruit and vegetable distribution solutions. The company's products include e Support link system for managing distribution information between different companies and departments that make up the supply chain online; Fresh Merchandise system, a cloud service for ordering and settling of perishable products; farm story that provides IT solution for creating valuable agriculture; pesticide search system, which develop pest and weed control guidelines; business outsourcing services for distribution of perishable products; support for fresh fruit and vegetable sales floors; and local vegetable procurement support service. It provides its services to producers/agricultural cooperatives, government, fresh food distribution industries, and retail/mass retailers. E-SUPPORTLINK, Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: E-SUPPORTLINK, Ltd. provides fresh fruit and vegetable distribution solutions. The company's products include e Support link system for managing distribution information between different companies and departments that make up the supply chain online; Fresh Merchandise system, a cloud service for ordering and settling of perishable products; farm story that provides IT solution for creating valuable agriculture; pesticide search system, which develop pest and weed control guidelines; business outsourcing services for distribution of perishable products; support for fresh fruit and vegetable sales floors; and local vegetable procurement support service. It provides its services to producers/agricultural cooperatives, government, fresh food distribution industries, and retail/mass retailers. E-SUPPORTLINK, Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: UNITED, Inc. engages in the ad-technology, content, and investment businesses in Japan. It operates through Investment Business; Education Business; Human Resources Matching Business; And Ad Tech/Content Business segments. The company is involved in investing in startup companies, investing in funds, and fund management activities; online education business, smartphone app development business, individual tutoring school business; recruitment process outsourcing services, such as sending out recruitment messages and providing recruitment support, as well as talent placement services and designer-focused matching services. It also engages in the Planning and development of an advertising distribution platform for advertisers and advertising agencies and operates advertising management platform for media companies. UNITED, Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. UNITED, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Hakuhodo DY ONE Inc.

Oriental Consultants Holdings Company Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the infrastructure management services business in Japan and internationally. The company offers consulting services, such as intellectual services for projects related to social environment development; construction surveys, design, supervision, GIS, spatial information, surveying, and measurement; traffic observation and analysis, and information processing; IT solutions related to construction management, measurement control, and asset management; and outsourcing and resource management related to human resources and business processes. It is also involved in equipment sales and rental; geological and soil surveys; environmental and environmental cleanup; structural surveys and renovations; hydraulic analysis, well drilling, demolition work, and hot spring construction; and residential land and construction transactions. The company was formerly known as ACKG Limited and changed its name to Oriental Consultants Holdings Company Limited in December 2018. Oriental Consultants Holdings Company Limited was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Oriental Consultants Holdings Company Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the infrastructure management services business in Japan and internationally. The company offers consulting services, such as intellectual services for projects related to social environment development; construction surveys, design, supervision, GIS, spatial information, surveying, and measurement; traffic observation and analysis, and information processing; IT solutions related to construction management, measurement control, and asset management; and outsourcing and resource management related to human resources and business processes. It is also involved in equipment sales and rental; geological and soil surveys; environmental and environmental cleanup; structural surveys and renovations; hydraulic analysis, well drilling, demolition work, and hot spring construction; and residential land and construction transactions. The company was formerly known as ACKG Limited and changed its name to Oriental Consultants Holdings Company Limited in December 2018. Oriental Consultants Holdings Company Limited was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Sapporo Breweries Limited engages in alcoholic beverages, foods and beverages, restaurants, and real estate businesses in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Alcoholic Beverages; and Food and Beverages segments. It manufactures, sale, and markets beer, wine, other alcoholic beverages, and other food products; spices, herbs, and dehydrated vegetables; ice cream and soup. The company is involved in operating restaurants, factories, and vending machines business; instore merchandising; provision of consigned freight forwarding, cargo handling and warehousing, and packaging and distribution processing. It sells its products under the POKKA, GINZA LION and YEBISU BAR brand name. The company was formerly known as Sapporo Holdings Limited and changed its name to Sapporo Breweries Limited in July 2026. The company was founded in 1876 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

business_summary: Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of beer, alcohol and non-alcohol beverages, and food products in Japan, Europe, Oceania, and Southeast Asia. The company offers alcoholic beverage products, including beers, non-alcohol beer, new genre, wines, shochu, whiskey and spirits, ready-to-drink beverages, and happoshu products. It also provides non-alcoholic beverage products beverages, such as carbonated drinks, coffee, tea, lactic acid bacteria drinks, and mineral water. It offers its products primarily under the Asahi Super Dry, Peroni Nastro Azzurro, Kozel, Pilsner Urquell, Grolsch, Great Northern, Victoria Bitter, Carlton Draught, Balter, Tyskie, Ursus, Radegast, Dreher, London Pride, Asahi Nama Beer, Captain Jack, Dry Zero, Great Northern Zero, Asahi Zero, Asahi Zeitaku Shibori, Mirai no Lemon Sour, Hard Rated, Nikka, Vodka Cruiser, Mitsuya, Wilkinson, Calpis, Wonda, Asahi Jurokucha, Asahi Oishiimizu, Solo, Cool Ridge, Allpress, Goodday, Mintia, Ippon Manzoku Bar, Dear-Natura, Amano Foods, and Wakodo. The company was formerly known as Asahi Breweries, Ltd. and changed its name to Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd. in July 2011. Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd. was founded in 1889 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Kirin Holdings Company, Limited engages in food and beverages, alcoholic beverages, pharmaceuticals, and health science businesses. The company's products include beer, wine, soft drinks, dairy products, margarine, jams, and honey. It engages in the management and operation of a chain of Kirin City beer pubs. The company also produces and sells pharmaceutical products. In addition, it manufactures and sells amino acids and nucleic acids for pharmaceutical and industrial use, as well as bulk pharmaceuticals, machines, cosmetics, and health foods. Further, the company provides logistics, accounting, human resources, and real estate services. Additionally, it is involved in the development of internal information systems and the manufacturing and sale of nutritional supplements. The company was formerly known as Kirin Brewery Company, Limited and changed its name to Kirin Holdings Company, Limited in July 2007. Kirin Holdings Company, Limited was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Nakano, Japan.

business_summary: Kirin Holdings Company, Limited engages in food and beverages, alcoholic beverages, pharmaceuticals, and health science businesses. The company's products include beer, wine, soft drinks, dairy products, margarine, jams, and honey. It engages in the management and operation of a chain of Kirin City beer pubs. The company also produces and sells pharmaceutical products. In addition, it manufactures and sells amino acids and nucleic acids for pharmaceutical and industrial use, as well as bulk pharmaceuticals, machines, cosmetics, and health foods. Further, the company provides logistics, accounting, human resources, and real estate services. Additionally, it is involved in the development of internal information systems and the manufacturing and sale of nutritional supplements. The company was formerly known as Kirin Brewery Company, Limited and changed its name to Kirin Holdings Company, Limited in July 2007. Kirin Holdings Company, Limited was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Nakano, Japan.

business_summary: Takara Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages and seasonings in Japan, the United States, and internationally. It operates through the Takara Shuzo, Takara Shuzo International Group, Takara Bio Group, and Other segments. The company offers alcoholic beverages, including shochu, sake, and light-alcohol refreshers; Scotch whisky, and alcohol-based seasonings, including Hon Mirin, food seasonings, and distilled raw alcohol, as well as engages in the sale of sundries, seafood, wine, bourbon whiskey, food ingredients, frozen food, and cookware and dinnerware for restaurants. It is also involved in the development, manufacture, and sale of reagents and instruments; contract development and manufacturing organization services for the development and manufacturing of regenerative medicine products; genetic analysis and testing; and genetic medicine and gene therapy. In addition, the company engages in the provision of logistics services, such as distribution processing and mail order/sales promotion distribution; transportation; warehousing; automobile services; non-life insurance agent; travel agent; wholesale of containers and packaging materials; digital; printing; and web production. Further, it offers market research; sales promotion planning; temporary staffing, store support, and office and technical work; sale of rice, wheat, and food byproducts, as well as feed comprising rice bran and corn meal; and real estate leasing. The company exports its products. Takara Holdings Inc. was founded in 1842 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

business_summary: TOBISHIMA HOLDINGS Inc. engages in the construction business in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the research, survey, planning, drafting, designing, supervision, and operation of civil engineering, construction work and contracting, as well as regional development, urban and marine development, and environmental enhancement; mediation of corporate acquisitions, mergers, company splits, share exchanges and transfers, business transfers, capital alliances, and business alliances; computer-based information processing and hardware and software development; and mediation for the formulation of corporate management strategies, organizational and business restructuring, and corporate revitalization, as well as non-life insurance agency, insurance agency, and life insurance solicitation businesses. It also engages in housing, real estate transaction, and real estate leasing businesses; planning, drafting, designing, holding, maintenance, management, operation, and management of public facilities; supply of energy, such as electricity and heat; contract maintenance and management of buildings and facilities incidental to buildings; entrustment of security and security; acquisition, licensing, and sale of industrial property rights, copyrights, and know-how; planning, design, manufacture, and sale of plant factories; and research and development related to the production of agricultural, forestry, and fishery products. In addition, the company manufactures, procures, sells, and leases construction machinery and equipment, civil engineering, and construction-related materials; produces, processes, and sells agricultural, forestry, and fishery products; provides worker dispatching and fee-based employment brokerage services, consulting services; and engages in projects related to the remediation of environmental pollution. TOBISHIMA HOLDINGS Inc. was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: TOBISHIMA HOLDINGS Inc. engages in the construction business in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the research, survey, planning, drafting, designing, supervision, and operation of civil engineering, construction work and contracting, as well as regional development, urban and marine development, and environmental enhancement; mediation of corporate acquisitions, mergers, company splits, share exchanges and transfers, business transfers, capital alliances, and business alliances; computer-based information processing and hardware and software development; and mediation for the formulation of corporate management strategies, organizational and business restructuring, and corporate revitalization, as well as non-life insurance agency, insurance agency, and life insurance solicitation businesses. It also engages in housing, real estate transaction, and real estate leasing businesses; planning, drafting, designing, holding, maintenance, management, operation, and management of public facilities; supply of energy, such as electricity and heat; contract maintenance and management of buildings and facilities incidental to buildings; entrustment of security and security; acquisition, licensing, and sale of industrial property rights, copyrights, and know-how; planning, design, manufacture, and sale of plant factories; and research and development related to the production of agricultural, forestry, and fishery products. In addition, the company manufactures, procures, sells, and leases construction machinery and equipment, civil engineering, and construction-related materials; produces, processes, and sells agricultural, forestry, and fishery products; provides worker dispatching and fee-based employment brokerage services, consulting services; and engages in projects related to the remediation of environmental pollution. TOBISHIMA HOLDINGS Inc. was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: TOBISHIMA HOLDINGS Inc. engages in the construction business in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the research, survey, planning, drafting, designing, supervision, and operation of civil engineering, construction work and contracting, as well as regional development, urban and marine development, and environmental enhancement; mediation of corporate acquisitions, mergers, company splits, share exchanges and transfers, business transfers, capital alliances, and business alliances; computer-based information processing and hardware and software development; and mediation for the formulation of corporate management strategies, organizational and business restructuring, and corporate revitalization, as well as non-life insurance agency, insurance agency, and life insurance solicitation businesses. It also engages in housing, real estate transaction, and real estate leasing businesses; planning, drafting, designing, holding, maintenance, management, operation, and management of public facilities; supply of energy, such as electricity and heat; contract maintenance and management of buildings and facilities incidental to buildings; entrustment of security and security; acquisition, licensing, and sale of industrial property rights, copyrights, and know-how; planning, design, manufacture, and sale of plant factories; and research and development related to the production of agricultural, forestry, and fishery products. In addition, the company manufactures, procures, sells, and leases construction machinery and equipment, civil engineering, and construction-related materials; produces, processes, and sells agricultural, forestry, and fishery products; provides worker dispatching and fee-based employment brokerage services, consulting services; and engages in projects related to the remediation of environmental pollution. TOBISHIMA HOLDINGS Inc. was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Ito En, Ltd. manufactures and sells green tea beverages in Japan and internationally. The company provides japanese tea, black tea, green tea, flavored tea, and chinese tea; coffee beverages; fruit, vegetable, and other beverages; and tea leaves. It also provides mineral water, carbonated drinks, and dairy beverages, as well as the purchasing, processing, and sales of raw materials. business_summary: Fuji Oil Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells food and processed soybean ingredients in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Southeast Asia, and China. The company operates through the Vegetable Oils and Fats, Commercial Chocolate, Emulsified and Fermented Ingredients, and Soybean Processed Ingredients segments. It offers hard butter for chocolate, confectionery oils and fats, frying and spraying oils, fats for frozen confectionery, emulsified oils and fats, powdered oils and fats, and lubricating/releasing oils. The company also provides industrial chocolates, including couverture chocolates, chocolates for ice cream coating and bread, chocolate chips, and stick chocolate for confectionery and bakery items; whipping cream, fillings, margarine, soymilk products, and cheese-flavored ingredients; and soy-based ingredients consisting of soy protein ingredients, soy protein products, and soluble soy polysaccharides. It serves manufacturers of distribution confections, frozen confections, dairy products, processed foods, and instant noodle dishes; convenience stores, supermarkets, other distributors, privately-owned pastry and bread stores, and restaurant chains; manufacturers of processed foods, beverages, and health food; and restaurants and pastry shops. The company was formerly known as Fuji Oil Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Fuji Oil Co., Ltd. in April 2025. Fuji Oil Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

It provides meals in various fields, such as hospital meals, office meals, school meals, and welfare facility meals for the elderly. The company also offers nursing care services; manages 10 Japanese restaurants in Hong Kong; and provides insurance products. Additionally, it engages in trust business, such as management of property for the elderly and maintenance of lump-sum payment for paid elderly home, as well as real estate leasing business. Further, the company operates home-visit and care establishments, pay nursing homes, and restaurants. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Asmo Corporation operates as a subsidiary of PersonsBridge Co., Ltd.

当社グループは、超高齢化社会に突入する日本において、多方面から必要とされる企業となるために、各事業のストロングポイントを的確に見極め、事業間シナジーを最大限に発揮し、また、多角的な収益構造を構築することで、人口減少時代を迎える日本において安定した成長を目指してまいりました。 この基本方針をベースとした、当社グループ主要企業の現況と、今後の目標・課題についてお伝えさせていただきます。 食肉の輸出入、食肉及び食肉加工品販売を行うアスモトレーディングは、2004年に国内で初めてメキシコ産チルド牛肉の取扱いを開始した実績が示すように「食肉マーケットの積極的な開拓力」が特徴です。 2020年から始まった日米貿易協定による牛肉関税の引き下げを絶好の好機と捉え、価格面と安定供給の実現化により顧客満足の拡充を追求してまいります。 主に高齢者介護施設における給食の提供を行うアスモフードサービスにおきましては、超高齢化社会の時代背景にマッチしたビジネスモデルにより安定的な成長を継続してまいりました。 今後も需要の高まりが予測される事業環境の中、グループのシナジーを活かした食材調達を進めるとともに、「適正な人員配置」や「教育体制の強化」を図ることでより安定的かつ弾力的な経営を目指してまいります。 訪問・居宅介護事業所の運営、有料老人ホームの運営を行うアスモ介護サービスにおきましては、「選択と集中」の事業方針のもと、介護施設向けに特化した訪問介護サービスや、ご利用者様の利便性を第一と考え、諸条件をクリアした有料老人ホームを運営しています。 現在、業界全体が人手不足で介護者の新規契約に苦戦する中で、働き方改革を追い風とした離職率の改善が成功し、安定したサービスの提供を可能としたことで、介護支援契約者数を増やしてまいりました。加えて、2019年8月には社会的ニーズの高まりに応えるべく「介護タクシー事業」を開始いたしました。 香港で日本食レストランを展開するアスモケータリング香港におきましては、「自社システムキッチンの所有」や「食肉卸売事業で培った国内及び海外での食材調達力」といった特徴を活かし、1985年の創業から35年の間に豊富な種類の日本食料理を提供できる独自の地位を確立してまいりました。 昨今は政情不安や新型コロナウイルスの影響により非常に厳しい状況が続いておりますが、セントラルキッチンを活用した事業者向け加工食品販売の営業強化や外食ニーズの変化に対応した惣菜ショップの出店拡大などにより、この危機を乗り越えてまいります。 business_summary: Asmo Corporation processed, imports and sells meat products in Japan, Taiwan, and China. It operates through ASMO Business; ASMO Trading Business; ASMO Food Services Business; ASMO service business; ASMO nursing care service business; and ASMOCATERING (HK) business. It provides meals in various fields, such as hospital meals, office meals, school meals, and welfare facility meals for the elderly. The company also offers nursing care services; manages 10 Japanese restaurants in Hong Kong; and provides insurance products. Additionally, it engages in trust business, such as management of property for the elderly and maintenance of lump-sum payment for paid elderly home, as well as real estate leasing business. Further, the company operates home-visit and care establishments, pay nursing homes, and restaurants. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Asmo Corporation operates as a subsidiary of PersonsBridge Co., Ltd.

当社グループは、超高齢化社会に突入する日本において、多方面から必要とされる企業となるために、各事業のストロングポイントを的確に見極め、事業間シナジーを最大限に発揮し、また、多角的な収益構造を構築することで、人口減少時代を迎える日本において安定した成長を目指してまいりました。 この基本方針をベースとした、当社グループ主要企業の現況と、今後の目標・課題についてお伝えさせていただきます。 食肉の輸出入、食肉及び食肉加工品販売を行うアスモトレーディングは、2004年に国内で初めてメキシコ産チルド牛肉の取扱いを開始した実績が示すように「食肉マーケットの積極的な開拓力」が特徴です。 2020年から始まった日米貿易協定による牛肉関税の引き下げを絶好の好機と捉え、価格面と安定供給の実現化により顧客満足の拡充を追求してまいります。 主に高齢者介護施設における給食の提供を行うアスモフードサービスにおきましては、超高齢化社会の時代背景にマッチしたビジネスモデルにより安定的な成長を継続してまいりました。 今後も需要の高まりが予測される事業環境の中、グループのシナジーを活かした食材調達を進めるとともに、「適正な人員配置」や「教育体制の強化」を図ることでより安定的かつ弾力的な経営を目指してまいります。 訪問・居宅介護事業所の運営、有料老人ホームの運営を行うアスモ介護サービスにおきましては、「選択と集中」の事業方針のもと、介護施設向けに特化した訪問介護サービスや、ご利用者様の利便性を第一と考え、諸条件をクリアした有料老人ホームを運営しています。 現在、業界全体が人手不足で介護者の新規契約に苦戦する中で、働き方改革を追い風とした離職率の改善が成功し、安定したサービスの提供を可能としたことで、介護支援契約者数を増やしてまいりました。加えて、2019年8月には社会的ニーズの高まりに応えるべく「介護タクシー事業」を開始いたしました。 香港で日本食レストランを展開するアスモケータリング香港におきましては、「自社システムキッチンの所有」や「食肉卸売事業で培った国内及び海外での食材調達力」といった特徴を活かし、1985年の創業から35年の間に豊富な種類の日本食料理を提供できる独自の地位を確立してまいりました。 昨今は政情不安や新型コロナウイルスの影響により非常に厳しい状況が続いておりますが、セントラルキッチンを活用した事業者向け加工食品販売の営業強化や外食ニーズの変化に対応した惣菜ショップの出店拡大などにより、この危機を乗り越えてまいります。 当社グループは、超高齢化社会に突入する日本において、多方面から必要とされる企業となるために、各事業のストロングポイントを的確に見極め、事業間シナジーを最大限に発揮し、また、多角的な収益構造を構築することで、人口減少時代を迎える日本において安定した成長を目指してまいりました。 この基本方針をベースとした、当社グループ主要企業の現況と、今後の目標・課題についてお伝えさせていただきます。 食肉の輸出入、食肉及び食肉加工品販売を行うアスモトレーディングは、2004年に国内で初めてメキシコ産チルド牛肉の取扱いを開始した実績が示すように「食肉マーケットの積極的な開拓力」が特徴です。 2020年から始まった日米貿易協定による牛肉関税の引き下げを絶好の好機と捉え、価格面と安定供給の実現化により顧客満足の拡充を追求してまいります。 主に高齢者介護施設における給食の提供を行うアスモフードサービスにおきましては、超高齢化社会の時代背景にマッチしたビジネスモデルにより安定的な成長を継続してまいりました。 今後も需要の高まりが予測される事業環境の中、グループのシナジーを活かした食材調達を進めるとともに、「適正な人員配置」や「教育体制の強化」を図ることでより安定的かつ弾力的な経営を目指してまいります。 訪問・居宅介護事業所の運営、有料老人ホームの運営を行うアスモ介護サービスにおきましては、「選択と集中」の事業方針のもと、介護施設向けに特化した訪問介護サービスや、ご利用者様の利便性を第一と考え、諸条件をクリアした有料老人ホームを運営しています。 現在、業界全体が人手不足で介護者の新規契約に苦戦する中で、働き方改革を追い風とした離職率の改善が成功し、安定したサービスの提供を可能としたことで、介護支援契約者数を増やしてまいりました。加えて、2019年8月には社会的ニーズの高まりに応えるべく「介護タクシー事業」を開始いたしました。 香港で日本食レストランを展開するアスモケータリング香港におきましては、「自社システムキッチンの所有」や「食肉卸売事業で培った国内及び海外での食材調達力」といった特徴を活かし、1985年の創業から35年の間に豊富な種類の日本食料理を提供できる独自の地位を確立してまいりました。 昨今は政情不安や新型コロナウイルスの影響により非常に厳しい状況が続いておりますが、セントラルキッチンを活用した事業者向け加工食品販売の営業強化や外食ニーズの変化に対応した惣菜ショップの出店拡大などにより、この危機を乗り越えてまいります。 様々な時代の変化の中で、今後も私たちアスモグループは、「食文化への貢献」と「超高齢化社会への貢献」を通じて弾力的に新しい価値を提供し、豊かな生活に貢献してまいります。 関係者の皆様方には、引き続きご支援ご鞭撻を賜りますよう、宜しくお願い申し上げます。 企業情報 企業名 株式会社アスモ（英語表記 ASMO CORPORATION） 設立 1975年（昭和50年）4月26日 資本金 business_summary: ImageONE Co., Ltd. provides healthcare and global environmental business solutions in Japan. The company's Healthcare Solutions Business segment sells medical image storage, distribution, and display systems, ultrasound image reporting systems, cloud-based electronic medical record systems, nuclear medicine dose management systems, medical gloves, PCR detection reagents, antigen test kits, etc., as well as remote image diagnosis and other businesses. The Global Environmental Solutions Business segment sells automatic orthomosaic and 3D processing software for UAV-captured images, etc. It offers medical systems, such as medical software and EHR/EMR, as well as PACS medical image storage, distribution, and display systems; medical supplies, medical gloves, and PCR and antigen test kits; CTs, MRIs, x-rays, and mobile medical trucks; and clinical management support services. The company also provides solar panels and wind turbines; and GEO mapping, GIS solution, and UAV capability services, as well as distributes and reuses EV batteries. In addition, it offers tritium separation technology; tritium continuous measurement; radiation tolerant cameras; viDocRTKrover, a measurement tool that uses tablet terminals; and 3D image processing software for use in construction, civil engineering, and surveying sites. business_summary: ImageONE Co., Ltd. provides healthcare and global environmental business solutions in Japan. The company's Healthcare Solutions Business segment sells medical image storage, distribution, and display systems, ultrasound image reporting systems, cloud-based electronic medical record systems, nuclear medicine dose management systems, medical gloves, PCR detection reagents, antigen test kits, etc., as well as remote image diagnosis and other businesses. The Global Environmental Solutions Business segment sells automatic orthomosaic and 3D processing software for UAV-captured images, etc. It offers medical systems, such as medical software and EHR/EMR, as well as PACS medical image storage, distribution, and display systems; medical supplies, medical gloves, and PCR and antigen test kits; CTs, MRIs, x-rays, and mobile medical trucks; and clinical management support services. The company also provides solar panels and wind turbines; and GEO mapping, GIS solution, and UAV capability services, as well as distributes and reuses EV batteries. In addition, it offers tritium separation technology; tritium continuous measurement; radiation tolerant cameras; viDocRTKrover, a measurement tool that uses tablet terminals; and 3D image processing software for use in construction, civil engineering, and surveying sites. The company serves companies, hospitals, medical institutions, government agencies, and power companies. ImageONE Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: ImageONE Co., Ltd. provides healthcare and global environmental business solutions in Japan. The company's Healthcare Solutions Business segment sells medical image storage, distribution, and display systems, ultrasound image reporting systems, cloud-based electronic medical record systems, nuclear medicine dose management systems, medical gloves, PCR detection reagents, antigen test kits, etc., as well as remote image diagnosis and other businesses. The Global Environmental Solutions Business segment sells automatic orthomosaic and 3D processing software for UAV-captured images, etc. It offers medical systems, such as medical software and EHR/EMR, as well as PACS medical image storage, distribution, and display systems; medical supplies, medical gloves, and PCR and antigen test kits; CTs, MRIs, x-rays, and mobile medical trucks; and clinical management support services. The company also provides solar panels and wind turbines; and GEO mapping, GIS solution, and UAV capability services, as well as distributes and reuses EV batteries. In addition, it offers tritium separation technology; tritium continuous measurement; radiation tolerant cameras; viDocRTKrover, a measurement tool that uses tablet terminals; and 3D image processing software for use in construction, civil engineering, and surveying sites. The company serves companies, hospitals, medical institutions, government agencies, and power companies. ImageONE Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: ImageONE Co., Ltd. provides healthcare and global environmental business solutions in Japan. The company's Healthcare Solutions Business segment sells medical image storage, distribution, and display systems, ultrasound image reporting systems, cloud-based electronic medical record systems, nuclear medicine dose management systems, medical gloves, PCR detection reagents, antigen test kits, etc., as well as remote image diagnosis and other businesses. The Global Environmental Solutions Business segment sells automatic orthomosaic and 3D processing software for UAV-captured images, etc. It offers medical systems, such as medical software and EHR/EMR, as well as PACS medical image storage, distribution, and display systems; medical supplies, medical gloves, and PCR and antigen test kits; CTs, MRIs, x-rays, and mobile medical trucks; and clinical management support services. The company also provides solar panels and wind turbines; and GEO mapping, GIS solution, and UAV capability services, as well as distributes and reuses EV batteries. In addition, it offers tritium separation technology; tritium continuous measurement; radiation tolerant cameras; viDocRTKrover, a measurement tool that uses tablet terminals; and 3D image processing software for use in construction, civil engineering, and surveying sites. The company serves companies, hospitals, medical institutions, government agencies, and power companies. ImageONE Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

The Global Environmental Solutions Business segment sells automatic orthomosaic and 3D processing software for UAV-captured images, etc. It offers medical systems, such as medical software and EHR/EMR, as well as PACS medical image storage, distribution, and display systems; medical supplies, medical gloves, and PCR and antigen test kits; CTs, MRIs, x-rays, and mobile medical trucks; and clinical management support services. The company also provides solar panels and wind turbines; and GEO mapping, GIS solution, and UAV capability services, as well as distributes and reuses EV batteries. In addition, it offers tritium separation technology; tritium continuous measurement; radiation tolerant cameras; viDocRTKrover, a measurement tool that uses tablet terminals; and 3D image processing software for use in construction, civil engineering, and surveying sites. The company serves companies, hospitals, medical institutions, government agencies, and power companies. ImageONE Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: ImageONE Co., Ltd. provides healthcare and global environmental business solutions in Japan. The company's Healthcare Solutions Business segment sells medical image storage, distribution, and display systems, ultrasound image reporting systems, cloud-based electronic medical record systems, nuclear medicine dose management systems, medical gloves, PCR detection reagents, antigen test kits, etc., as well as remote image diagnosis and other businesses. The Global Environmental Solutions Business segment sells automatic orthomosaic and 3D processing software for UAV-captured images, etc. It offers medical systems, such as medical software and EHR/EMR, as well as PACS medical image storage, distribution, and display systems; medical supplies, medical gloves, and PCR and antigen test kits; CTs, MRIs, x-rays, and mobile medical trucks; and clinical management support services. The company also provides solar panels and wind turbines; and GEO mapping, GIS solution, and UAV capability services, as well as distributes and reuses EV batteries. In addition, it offers tritium separation technology; tritium continuous measurement; radiation tolerant cameras; viDocRTKrover, a measurement tool that uses tablet terminals; and 3D image processing software for use in construction, civil engineering, and surveying sites. The company serves companies, hospitals, medical institutions, government agencies, and power companies. ImageONE Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: YUMEMITSUKETAI Co.,Ltd. engages in the value-added mail order business in Japan. It offers fashion accessories, men's apparel, women's fashion, household goods, AV equipment, car accessories, healing goods, business and stationery, as well as beauty, health, food, golf, and hobby products through its own catalogs and website. The company is also involved in the real estate business; and elderly care business. YUMEMITSUKETAI Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

business_summary: Takachiho Koheki Co.,Ltd. operates as a technology trading company in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It offers mechanical component products, including slide rails, cable guides, conston springs, dampers, gas springs, lifting and cylinder lock systems, monitor arms, and other mechanical components; and semiconductor products, such as communication devices, power modules and devices, sensors, connectors, trans, coils, and GPU boards. The company also provides retail security products comprising electronic article surveillance, display product security, image surveillance, image analysis, store management, and remote monitoring systems, as well as source tagging labels; and business solution products consisting of WAN/LAN and network security products, as well as office security products, such as access control and properties removal management systems, and IP solutions/IP cameras/NVR systems. In addition, it offers video sensing cloud service, estimation for male and female customers, shelf browsing time service, and IQ Lane, a checkout service; and support, maintenance, operation and management, installation, and tuning solutions. Further, the company offers fire protection systems; services for interconnected plants, natural gas and petrochemical plants, and other similar facilities; consulting services; self-alarming tag systems; and sales of cloud services, including MSP services. Takachiho Koheki Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

business_summary: Takachiho Koheki Co.,Ltd. operates as a technology trading company in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It offers mechanical component products, including slide rails, cable guides, conston springs, dampers, gas springs, lifting and cylinder lock systems, monitor arms, and other mechanical components; and semiconductor products, such as communication devices, power modules and devices, sensors, connectors, trans, coils, and GPU boards. The company also provides retail security products comprising electronic article surveillance, display product security, image surveillance, image analysis, store management, and remote monitoring systems, as well as source tagging labels; and business solution products consisting of WAN/LAN and network security products, as well as office security products, such as access control and properties removal management systems, and IP solutions/IP cameras/NVR systems. In addition, it offers video sensing cloud service, estimation for male and female customers, shelf browsing time service, and IQ Lane, a checkout service; and support, maintenance, operation and management, installation, and tuning solutions. Further, the company offers fire protection systems; services for interconnected plants, natural gas and petrochemical plants, and other similar facilities; consulting services; self-alarming tag systems; and sales of cloud services, including MSP services. Takachiho Koheki Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

It offers mechanical component products, including slide rails, cable guides, conston springs, dampers, gas springs, lifting and cylinder lock systems, monitor arms, and other mechanical components; and semiconductor products, such as communication devices, power modules and devices, sensors, connectors, trans, coils, and GPU boards. The company also provides retail security products comprising electronic article surveillance, display product security, image surveillance, image analysis, store management, and remote monitoring systems, as well as source tagging labels; and business solution products consisting of WAN/LAN and network security products, as well as office security products, such as access control and properties removal management systems, and IP solutions/IP cameras/NVR systems. In addition, it offers video sensing cloud service, estimation for male and female customers, shelf browsing time service, and IQ Lane, a checkout service; and support, maintenance, operation and management, installation, and tuning solutions. Further, the company offers fire protection systems; services for interconnected plants, natural gas and petrochemical plants, and other similar facilities; consulting services; self-alarming tag systems; and sales of cloud services, including MSP services. Takachiho Koheki Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

business_summary: Takachiho Koheki Co.,Ltd. operates as a technology trading company in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It offers mechanical component products, including slide rails, cable guides, conston springs, dampers, gas springs, lifting and cylinder lock systems, monitor arms, and other mechanical components; and semiconductor products, such as communication devices, power modules and devices, sensors, connectors, trans, coils, and GPU boards. The company also provides retail security products comprising electronic article surveillance, display product security, image surveillance, image analysis, store management, and remote monitoring systems, as well as source tagging labels; and business solution products consisting of WAN/LAN and network security products, as well as office security products, such as access control and properties removal management systems, and IP solutions/IP cameras/NVR systems. In addition, it offers video sensing cloud service, estimation for male and female customers, shelf browsing time service, and IQ Lane, a checkout service; and support, maintenance, operation and management, installation, and tuning solutions. Further, the company offers fire protection systems; services for interconnected plants, natural gas and petrochemical plants, and other similar facilities; consulting services; self-alarming tag systems; and sales of cloud services, including MSP services. Takachiho Koheki Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

business_summary: ASKUL Corporation engages in e-commerce business in Japan. The company operates ASKUL, a website for small and medium-sized enterprises, as well as SOLOEL ARENA, a website for mid-tier and larger companies that provides office supplies, living supplies, furniture, general medical, pharmaceuticals, and medical equipment products. It also provides various services comprising make printed materials, such as business cards, envelopes, stamps, and personalized novelty goods; office coordinate services; and support services on an e-commerce website where customers can get advice by professional staffs, as well as sells SaaS, communication tools, and seminars for beginners. In addition, the company sells maintenance, repair, and operation supplies; provision of purchase solutions for large companies, and e-commerce website of professional items for dentists; and engages in agent business. Further, it is involved in the operation of e-commerce site for pet and gardening products; provision of logistics and small-cargo transportation, product storage, warehouse management, and delivery services for manufacturers and direct-order companies; and produces and sells bottled natural mineral water. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Geo Holdings Corporation engages in the operation of various used and new product stores in Japan. The company operates 2nd STREET, a store that buys and sells fashion items, furniture, household electrical appliances, and daily necessities; OKURA, a store for luxury products procured from commercial auctioneers through e-commerce and online auctions; Luck Rack, an off-price store for second-hand goods; GEO, a store that offers amusement products; and Mobile, an outlet that provides smartphones, tablets, earphones, smartwatches, SIM cards, and other smartphone peripherals. It is also involved in the development of a platform that consists of digital content, as well as production and sale of content; operation of amusement facility; wholesale and trading of fashion and lifestyle goods; and system development activities. In addition, the company operates Pleasure, a store that purchases used agricultural machinery; Kotaro, a store that purchases antiques and paintings; 2nd STORAGE, a self-storage service with free home pick-up and delivery; and GEO Are Kore Rental, a rental service for cameras, smartphones, home appliances, and other items. Geo Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

UOGroup CO.,LTD. engages in the retail sale of seafood in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Fresh Fish Business, Food and Beverage Business, and Real Estate Business. The Fresh Fish Business segment offers fresh fish, sushi, and prepared food products. The Food and Beverage Business segment operates conveyor belt sushi restaurants. The Real Estate Business segment manages, operates, and rents supermarkets. The company operates 38 fresh fish retail stores, 7 restaurants, and 2 take-out specialty stores. The company was formerly known as Uoki Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to UOGroup CO.,LTD. in May 2026. UOGroup CO.,LTD. was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Fujisawa, Japan.

business_summary: CVS Bay Area Inc. engages in apartment front desk service business in Japan. The company operates through Hotel, Apartment Reception Service, Cleaning Service, Convenience Store Business, and Other segments. It operates business and unit hotels under the BAY HOTEL brand name. The company also provides cleaning referral service centered on the contracted service of apartment front desk services for apartment residents, management associations, and management companies; lifestyle support services for residents, such as managing cafes and shops, planning and support for events; and undertakes reception duties. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of cleaning services for clothes and curtains in educational institutions, and sheets and uniforms in hotels and other accommodation facilities, as well as house cleaning and clothing storage and individual delivery services; linen supply service for corporations that handles sheets and uniforms for hotels and other accommodation facilities; operates Lawson stores that provides retail sales of fast food, such as rice, side dishes, and other foods and daily necessities, as well as the collection and payment of utility bills. Further, it engages in the operation of hair cutting salons; real estate rental business; and provision of support for development and rebranding of existing facilities. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Chiba, Japan.

business_summary: OLBA DVx HEALTHCARE, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a distributor of medical equipment and pharmaceuticals in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Medical Equipment Business, Specialty Product Delivery (SPD) Business, and Nursing Care Products Business. The Medical Equipment Business segment engages in the wholesale of medical equipment comprising artificial joints, coronary stents, steel instruments, osteosynthesis materials made of metal and ceramics, ultrasonic scalpels, and pacemakers and catheters related to examination, diagnosis, and treatment of the heart and blood vessels; X-ray fluoroscopy and CT equipment for tumor and embolism treatment, and endoscopes for cancer treatment; and diagnostic imaging equipment, such as MRI and CT to ventilators, and intraoperative monitors, as well as operating room equipment, including shadowless lights. This segment also offers reagents and equipment for genetic research, cell culture, and protein analysis; automatic analyzers for biochemical, immunological, and blood; and test reagents, as well as undertakes services for DNA analysis in the field of life sciences. The Specialty Product Delivery (SPD) Business segment provides inventory management, medical material masters and data analysis, and purchase management services. The Nursing Care Products Business segment engages in the sale and rental of nursing care equipment; the sale of welfare equipment, such as portable toilets and bathing chairs; and home renovation works, as well as provides nursing care services. The company was formerly known as OLBA HEALTHCARE HOLDINGS, Inc. and changed its name to OLBA DVx HEALTHCARE, Inc. in September 2026. OLBA DVx HEALTHCARE, Inc. was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

business_summary: OLBA DVx HEALTHCARE, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a distributor of medical equipment and pharmaceuticals in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Medical Equipment Business, Specialty Product Delivery (SPD) Business, and Nursing Care Products Business. The Medical Equipment Business segment engages in the wholesale of medical equipment comprising artificial joints, coronary stents, steel instruments, osteosynthesis materials made of metal and ceramics, ultrasonic scalpels, and pacemakers and catheters related to examination, diagnosis, and treatment of the heart and blood vessels; X-ray fluoroscopy and CT equipment for tumor and embolism treatment, and endoscopes for cancer treatment; and diagnostic imaging equipment, such as MRI and CT to ventilators, and intraoperative monitors, as well as operating room equipment, including shadowless lights. This segment also offers reagents and equipment for genetic research, cell culture, and protein analysis; automatic analyzers for biochemical, immunological, and blood; and test reagents, as well as undertakes services for DNA analysis in the field of life sciences. The Specialty Product Delivery (SPD) Business segment provides inventory management, medical material masters and data analysis, and purchase management services. The Nursing Care Products Business segment engages in the sale and rental of nursing care equipment; the sale of welfare equipment, such as portable toilets and bathing chairs; and home renovation works, as well as provides nursing care services. The company was formerly known as OLBA HEALTHCARE HOLDINGS, Inc. and changed its name to OLBA DVx HEALTHCARE, Inc. in September 2026. OLBA DVx HEALTHCARE, Inc. was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

business_summary: Rigaku Holdings Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of scientific equipment in Japan, the United States, Europe, and Asia. business_summary: Yakiniku Sakai Holdings Inc. operates in the food service industry in Japan. The company engages in the restaurant business, operating a variety of dining establishments, including yakiniku restaurants under the brands Nikusho Sakai and Yakinikuya Sakai, sushi restaurants under the Heiroku Sushi brand, izakaya restaurants such as Toriaezu Gohei and Murasara, as well as fast food restaurants including Omuraisutei and Nagasaki Chanmen; and franchise and food processing businesses, as well as business revitalization consulting business. In addition. It operates an Italian restaurant chain; food and beverage businesses; steak and curry restaurants. The company was formerly known as G.taste Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Yakiniku Sakai Holdings Inc. in July 2021. Yakiniku Sakai Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

私たちの使命は、当社に関わるすべての人が、食を通して幸せを感じられる場所をつくり、その幸せを“笑顔”という輪にして社会へと広げていくこと。 そのために最も大切にしているのは「人」です。 当グループには、料理人や接客のプロフェッショナルはもちろんのこと、商品開発・設計・デザイン・システム・物流・管理部門まで、あらゆる分野において専門性を磨く“クラフトマン”が集っています。 私たちは、職種にかかわらず、すべての社員が自らの力を最大限に発揮し、プロとして誇りを持ち続ける集団でありたいと考えています。 たとえ技術が進化し、効率化が進んでも、食の本質は決して変わりません。 お客様の心を動かすのは、「美味しさ」と「おもてなしの心」 そして、それを支える「人の情熱と技術」です。 私たちは、世の中がどんなに変化しても、本質的に変わらないものを常に大切にする「不易流行」の精神のもと、時代の変化に柔軟に対応しながら常に進化をつづけます。 “食”という舞台で、人が輝き、笑顔が生まれ、社会が豊かになる。 これからも、よりよい未来を見据え、挑戦と成長を続けてまいります。 代表取締役社長 髙橋 仁志 ビジョン Vision Vision 01 笑顔職人宣言 私たちは、食を通じて人々を笑顔にする“笑顔職人”を目指します。 美味しい料理と心のこもったおもてなしで、お客様に「最高の幸せ」を届け、 笑顔を生み出すことに常に真摯であり続けます。 仲間を尊重し、支え合う姿勢が「笑顔」を生み、 その笑顔が、仕事に対する誇りと充実感を育んでいく。 私たちは、そんな笑顔の循環を大切にしています。 当社に関わるすべての人が幸せを感じられる場所をつくり、 「笑顔」の輪を広げていくことが私たちの使命です。 Vision 02 Be Professional 私たちは、一人ひとりがプロフェッショナルとしての誇りを持ち、 常に成長し続ける集団でありたいと考えています。 食のプロとして、お客様に最高の食体験を提供するために、 現状に満足することなく、技術やサービスの向上に努めます。 店舗の最前線で働く社員はもちろん、運営を支えるすべての社員が、 個々の技術と精神を磨き、自らの価値を高めることで、 さらなる進化と挑戦を続け、地域社会に貢献できる存在を目指します。 Vision 03 伝統と挑戦 当グループには、半世紀以上の歴史を誇るブランドが多く存在します。 その長い歴史の中で、 【平禄寿司】は、東日本で初めて回転寿司を広め、 【壁の穴】は、たらこスパゲッティを生み出し、 【村さ来】は、酎ハイを考案し、大衆居酒屋文化を創りました。 The company engages in the restaurant business, operating a variety of dining establishments, including yakiniku restaurants under the brands Nikusho Sakai and Yakinikuya Sakai, sushi restaurants under the Heiroku Sushi brand, izakaya restaurants such as Toriaezu Gohei and Murasara, as well as fast food restaurants including Omuraisutei and Nagasaki Chanmen; and franchise and food processing businesses, as well as business revitalization consulting business. In addition. It operates an Italian restaurant chain; food and beverage businesses; steak and curry restaurants. The company was formerly known as G.taste Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Yakiniku Sakai Holdings Inc. in July 2021. Yakiniku Sakai Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

私たちの使命は、当社に関わるすべての人が、食を通して幸せを感じられる場所をつくり、その幸せを“笑顔”という輪にして社会へと広げていくこと。 そのために最も大切にしているのは「人」です。 当グループには、料理人や接客のプロフェッショナルはもちろんのこと、商品開発・設計・デザイン・システム・物流・管理部門まで、あらゆる分野において専門性を磨く“クラフトマン”が集っています。 私たちは、職種にかかわらず、すべての社員が自らの力を最大限に発揮し、プロとして誇りを持ち続ける集団でありたいと考えています。 たとえ技術が進化し、効率化が進んでも、食の本質は決して変わりません。 お客様の心を動かすのは、「美味しさ」と「おもてなしの心」 そして、それを支える「人の情熱と技術」です。 私たちは、世の中がどんなに変化しても、本質的に変わらないものを常に大切にする「不易流行」の精神のもと、時代の変化に柔軟に対応しながら常に進化をつづけます。 “食”という舞台で、人が輝き、笑顔が生まれ、社会が豊かになる。 これからも、よりよい未来を見据え、挑戦と成長を続けてまいります。 代表取締役社長 髙橋 仁志 ビジョン Vision Vision 01 笑顔職人宣言 私たちは、食を通じて人々を笑顔にする“笑顔職人”を目指します。 美味しい料理と心のこもったおもてなしで、お客様に「最高の幸せ」を届け、 笑顔を生み出すことに常に真摯であり続けます。 仲間を尊重し、支え合う姿勢が「笑顔」を生み、 その笑顔が、仕事に対する誇りと充実感を育んでいく。 私たちは、そんな笑顔の循環を大切にしています。 当社に関わるすべての人が幸せを感じられる場所をつくり、 「笑顔」の輪を広げていくことが私たちの使命です。 Vision 02 Be Professional 私たちは、一人ひとりがプロフェッショナルとしての誇りを持ち、 常に成長し続ける集団でありたいと考えています。 食のプロとして、お客様に最高の食体験を提供するために、 現状に満足することなく、技術やサービスの向上に努めます。 店舗の最前線で働く社員はもちろん、運営を支えるすべての社員が、 個々の技術と精神を磨き、自らの価値を高めることで、 さらなる進化と挑戦を続け、地域社会に貢献できる存在を目指します。 Vision 03 伝統と挑戦 当グループには、半世紀以上の歴史を誇るブランドが多く存在します。 その長い歴史の中で、 【平禄寿司】は、東日本で初めて回転寿司を広め、 【壁の穴】は、たらこスパゲッティを生み出し、 【村さ来】は、酎ハイを考案し、大衆居酒屋文化を創りました。 business_summary: EDION Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a home appliance retailer in Japan. It also sells personal computers, printers, multifunction devices, various office equipment, projectors, video conferencing systems, office lighting products, commercial air conditioners, digital camera drive and recorder drones, ceremony, event prizes, souvenirs, smartphones, IP phones, and mobile routers; and operates mobile shops. The company engages in robot programming education, energy management systems, real estate brokerage, photovoltaic power generation systems, renovation and housing related businesses, as well as operate as a communication internet service provider. It operates home electronics stores under the EDION brand; EDION net shop, an online shop; and franchised stores. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

business_summary: SALA Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the energy supply and solution business in Japan. The company operates through Energy & Solutions Business, Engineering & Maintenance Business, Housing Business, Car Life Support Business, Animal Health Care Business, and Property Business segments. It provides natural gas and LP gas/petroleum products; sells heat and electricity; and generates biomass power, as well as engages in the transportation of gas and petroleum, and delivery services for private homes. The company also engages in the water delivery, renovation, and cultural lectures and cooking classes businesses. In addition, it develops social infrastructure facilities, including office buildings, hospitals, schools, condominiums, parks, roads, bridges, and harbor facilities; manufactures and sells construction materials; offers infrastructure maintenance services to urban functions, such as gas, water supply/sewage, civil engineering, paving, and harbor construction; and provides integrated services comprising electric, air conditioning, and plumbing design, as well as construction and maintenance. Further, the company engages in the system development business for various industries, including factories and universities; develops houses; operates automobile dealerships; provides automobile inspection and maintenance services; and sells pet pharmaceuticals, as well as provides dietetic treatment for unwell or obese animals for recovery and health management. Additionally, it operates restaurants under the SHISEN HANTEN and XIÈ XIÈ names; and hotels and sports clubs, as well as offers real estate leasing and brokerage services. The company also provides various insurance/financing products and credit cards; and manufactures electronic equipment for automobiles and motorcycles. SALA Corporation was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Toyohashi, Japan.
