business_summary: MIC Co., Ltd. provides retail sales promotion support services in Japan. It offers support services from manufacturing to delivery, and display of promotional tools; PromOS, a cloud-based platform that manages systems and information related to sales promotion; Co.HUB, a joint delivery service that consolidates promotional tools from each manufacturer at a promotion management center and delivers them to stores; and designer on-site support services. The company also provides business improvement consulting, system development, BPO, creative designing, printing, fulfillment, and field supporting services. MIC Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. MIC Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of M2 Corporation.

It also provides tenant management services, and consulting and proposal services for investment in real estate properties. business_summary: Applied Co.,Ltd. sells computers, peripherals, and digital products in Japan, Asia, and the United States. It operates in three segments: PC and Game Business; Cosmetics and Miscellaneous Goods Business; and Publishing and Advertising Business. The company engages in planning, development, and wholesale of private-branded PCs, games, home appliances, general merchandise, store equipment, cosmetics, and sundries, as well as provision of PC-related support services and contract software development. It is also involved in the manufacture and sale of HPC for research and development; web services and mail order site management; network system construction and maintenance; remote service business; AI solution and system development; and solutions sale for government agencies, research institutions, and universities. In addition, the company publishes information magazines and project books; plans, procures, and advertises products from manufacturers; and engages in event planning and management. Further, it manages specialty stores; and closed and cultural sites. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

business_summary: Pacific Net Co.,Ltd. engages in the rental, maintenance, and operation of IT equipment in Japan. It operates through three segments: IT Subscription Business, ITAD Business, and Communication Device Business. The company is involved in the rental of PCs, tablets, and communication devices; sale of reused PCs; and manufacturing, sale, rental, and maintenance of guide receivers. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Pacific Net Co.,Ltd. engages in the rental, maintenance, and operation of IT equipment in Japan. It operates through three segments: IT Subscription Business, ITAD Business, and Communication Device Business. The company is involved in the rental of PCs, tablets, and communication devices; sale of reused PCs; and manufacturing, sale, rental, and maintenance of guide receivers. It also provides collection, data erasure, reuse, and recycling of used IT equipment; and IT construction/operation agency services, including kitting work, help desk, PC-LCM outsourcing, and cloud implementation and operation. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Rasa Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, trades in and supplies various products in Japan, Singapore, China, Thailand, Asia, and internationally. It operates through six segments: Resources and Metallic Materials, Industrial and Construction Machineries, Environmental Equipment, Chemical, Industrial Plants and Equipment, and Real Estate. The company imports, exports, and sells mineral sand products, including zircon and rutile sand, ilmenite, and others; industrial materials, such as phosphoric, anhydrous phosphoric, and phosphorous acid, second phosphorus finished goods, malp, aluminum hydroxide, polychlorinated aluminum, aluminum sulfate, metallic manganese, metallic silicon and nickel, talc, China clay, silica, boron carbide, electrolytic manganese, and others; and refractory raw materials comprising calcined, low soda, spherical, and other fused alumina, zirconium and lithium compounds, fused spinel, spherical and fused silica power, graphite, black and green silicon carbide, B4C, and others. It also offers industrial machineries, which include pumps, valves, mixers, crushers, strainers, cyclons, pressure washers, rubber joints, and others; construction equipment, such as pipe jacking machines, handheld gas-powered breakers, pipe cutting machines, concrete pumps/mixers, mini crawler cranes, and others; and environmental equipment comprising RASA slag granulation system and PARA-ECO-recycling system. In addition, the company provides plastic synthetic resins and resin additives; sheets, resin films, tapes, and metal foils; extruded and injection-molded materials; oil and fat, and other chemical products. Further, it is involved in the design, installation, and maintenance services for equipment used in oil refineries, petrochemical plants, and other production facilities; and revitalization and leasing of real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Create Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale of plumbing materials under the TORO brand in Japan. It operates through Plumbing Equipment, Construction Related, and Logistics Related segments. The company offers plumbing fittings and water taps, water supply pipe equipment, and drainage pipe equipment; and housing equipment, such as air-conditioners. It is also involved in the import of iron castings; sale of drainage pipe fittings and drainage implements; processing and production of resinous plumbing systems; construction; and transportation services. The company was formerly known as Fukui Kazuo Shoten Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Create Corporation in April 1993. Create Corporation was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: RACCOON HOLDINGS, Inc. creates and provides infrastructure BtoB transactions in Japan. The company operates SUPER DELIVERY, a wholesale purchasing site for manufacturers of apparel and general good, and businesses, such as retail stores, restaurants, and hair salons; COREC, a cloud-based ordering system; and SD Export for developing overseas market. It offers Paid, a BtoB payment service; online receivables guarantee services; and guaranteed online services for small and medium-sized business, as well as rent guarantee services for individuals and business use for offices or stores. In addition, the company offers URIHO, sales guarantee service that guarantees the price of transactions in place of the accounts even if the account does not pay due to financial difficulties or bankruptcy. The company was formerly known as Raccoon Co., Ltd. and changed its name to RACCOON HOLDINGS, Inc. in November 2018. RACCOON HOLDINGS, Inc. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: ALCONIX Corporation imports, exports, and sells non-ferrous metal products in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Electronic and Advanced Materials, Aluminum and Copper, Equipment and Materials, and Metal Processing. The company was formerly known as Nissho Iwai Alconix Corporation and changed its name to ALCONIX Corporation in April 2005. ALCONIX Corporation was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

business_summary: ALCONIX Corporation imports, exports, and sells non-ferrous metal products in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Electronic and Advanced Materials, Aluminum and Copper, Equipment and Materials, and Metal Processing. The company is involved in the trading of electronic and advanced materials, including materials for electronic materials and components, minor metal and rare earth raw materials (ore and ingot), and battery-related parts and materials. It also engages in the manufacture of equipment and materials related to inspection and measurement of products, and materials used in testing equipment, automotive, chemical products and new materials fields; and electronic devices, plating materials for semiconductors and busbars for power distribution. In addition, the company involved in the aluminum and copper, contains base metal products and titanium roll flat materials, and base metal materials; metal processing, which include precision cutting parts used in industrial machinery, such as semiconductor manufacturing equipment, air conditioning equipment, and aircraft engines; grinding parts in fields of semiconductors, automobiles, and industrial machinery; and metal stamped parts, automobiles, batteries, and IT equipment fields. The company was formerly known as Nissho Iwai Alconix Corporation and changed its name to ALCONIX Corporation in April 2005. ALCONIX Corporation was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

business_summary: ALCONIX Corporation imports, exports, and sells non-ferrous metal products in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Electronic and Advanced Materials, Aluminum and Copper, Equipment and Materials, and Metal Processing. The company is involved in the trading of electronic and advanced materials, including materials for electronic materials and components, minor metal and rare earth raw materials (ore and ingot), and battery-related parts and materials. It also engages in the manufacture of equipment and materials related to inspection and measurement of products, and materials used in testing equipment, automotive, chemical products and new materials fields; and electronic devices, plating materials for semiconductors and busbars for power distribution. In addition, the company involved in the aluminum and copper, contains base metal products and titanium roll flat materials, and base metal materials; metal processing, which include precision cutting parts used in industrial machinery, such as semiconductor manufacturing equipment, air conditioning equipment, and aircraft engines; grinding parts in fields of semiconductors, automobiles, and industrial machinery; and metal stamped parts, automobiles, batteries, and IT equipment fields. The company was formerly known as Nissho Iwai Alconix Corporation and changed its name to ALCONIX Corporation in April 2005. ALCONIX Corporation was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

business_summary: ALCONIX Corporation imports, exports, and sells non-ferrous metal products in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Electronic and Advanced Materials, Aluminum and Copper, Equipment and Materials, and Metal Processing. The company is involved in the trading of electronic and advanced materials, including materials for electronic materials and components, minor metal and rare earth raw materials (ore and ingot), and battery-related parts and materials. It also engages in the manufacture of equipment and materials related to inspection and measurement of products, and materials used in testing equipment, automotive, chemical products and new materials fields; and electronic devices, plating materials for semiconductors and busbars for power distribution. In addition, the company involved in the aluminum and copper, contains base metal products and titanium roll flat materials, and base metal materials; metal processing, which include precision cutting parts used in industrial machinery, such as semiconductor manufacturing equipment, air conditioning equipment, and aircraft engines; grinding parts in fields of semiconductors, automobiles, and industrial machinery; and metal stamped parts, automobiles, batteries, and IT equipment fields. The company was formerly known as Nissho Iwai Alconix Corporation and changed its name to ALCONIX Corporation in April 2005. ALCONIX Corporation was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

business_summary: Soliton Systems K.K., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and sale of IT security-related products in Japan, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: IT Security, Video Communication, and Eco New Business Development. It offers authentication-based logon control, data access control, log collection system, and network isolation; and cybersecurity measures, cyber threat intelligence, data breach investigations, and CSIRT-related services. The company also develops and sells Smart-telecaster, a real-time image transmission system using 4G and 5G mobile lines; remote control of vehicles and heavy machinery; mixed analog and digital semiconductor devices; and special video transmission system. In addition, it provides various solutions, including security measures for educational and local government information systems; management of IT assets; telework and healthcare solutions; and internet isolation. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

business_summary: Soliton Systems K.K., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and sale of IT security-related products in Japan, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: IT Security, Video Communication, and Eco New Business Development. It offers authentication-based logon control, data access control, log collection system, and network isolation; and cybersecurity measures, cyber threat intelligence, data breach investigations, and CSIRT-related services. The company also develops and sells Smart-telecaster, a real-time image transmission system using 4G and 5G mobile lines; remote control of vehicles and heavy machinery; mixed analog and digital semiconductor devices; and special video transmission system. In addition, it provides various solutions, including security measures for educational and local government information systems; management of IT assets; telework and healthcare solutions; and internet isolation. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

It offers authentication-based logon control, data access control, log collection system, and network isolation; and cybersecurity measures, cyber threat intelligence, data breach investigations, and CSIRT-related services. The company also develops and sells Smart-telecaster, a real-time image transmission system using 4G and 5G mobile lines; remote control of vehicles and heavy machinery; mixed analog and digital semiconductor devices; and special video transmission system. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

business_summary: Soliton Systems K.K., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and sale of IT security-related products in Japan, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: IT Security, Video Communication, and Eco New Business Development. It offers authentication-based logon control, data access control, log collection system, and network isolation; and cybersecurity measures, cyber threat intelligence, data breach investigations, and CSIRT-related services. The company also develops and sells Smart-telecaster, a real-time image transmission system using 4G and 5G mobile lines; remote control of vehicles and heavy machinery; mixed analog and digital semiconductor devices; and special video transmission system. In addition, it provides various solutions, including security measures for educational and local government information systems; management of IT assets; telework and healthcare solutions; and internet isolation. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

business_summary: Soliton Systems K.K., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and sale of IT security-related products in Japan, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: IT Security, Video Communication, and Eco New Business Development. It offers authentication-based logon control, data access control, log collection system, and network isolation; and cybersecurity measures, cyber threat intelligence, data breach investigations, and CSIRT-related services. The company also develops and sells Smart-telecaster, a real-time image transmission system using 4G and 5G mobile lines; remote control of vehicles and heavy machinery; mixed analog and digital semiconductor devices; and special video transmission system. In addition, it provides various solutions, including security measures for educational and local government information systems; management of IT assets; telework and healthcare solutions; and internet isolation. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

The company is involved in the design, construction, operation, monitoring, sales, and log analysis of computer network security systems. It sell network equipment and product maintenance; provide network construction and security operation monitoring services. The company provides integrated security operations; firewall operation monitoring; FortiGate operation; Palo Alto operation; SonicWall UTM operation; F5 BIG-IP ASM operation; Ransomware attack detection service; Aurora Managed EDR Service; Network Threat Detection Security diagnostic service; and Vulnerability assessment service. Its products include NetStare, a network security operation monitoring system. The company is also involved in the training and dispatch of information security personnel. It serves hospitals, automotive, and IT/OT separation SOC service for factories. SecuAvail Inc. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

business_summary: Bic Camera Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of audiovisual products in Japan. It offers cameras, televisions, recorders/video cameras, audio, refrigerators, washing machines, cooking appliances, seasonal appliances, beauty and hairdressing appliances; and home appliances, personal computers, and computer peripherals, as well as information and communication equipment products, such as mobile phones, games, watches, used computers, sporting goods, toys, glasses, and contact lens. The company also sells equipment, alcohol, food and beverages, medicines, daily necessities, and other products; plans, develops, and operates web services; manufactures and sells beddings; sells and purchases computers and digital devices; manufactures and sells drinking water; operates mobile phone sales agency; and provides data processing services and its contracting. In addition, it is involved in advertising agency, real estate and management, and golf course operation; general cargo transportation/warehousing; joint financial; and cable television and BS digital broadcasting businesses. The company sells its products through a network of stores, as well as online. Bic Camera Inc. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

FORCIA, Inc. operates a digital business platform in Japan. It primarily offers search platform development and consulting services. The company offers Spook, a technological platform that processes data; WebConnect, a product sales and business management platform for the travel and tourism industry; and Value Connect, which connects providers and sellers of tourism resources. FORCIA, Inc. was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: HYPER Inc. engaged in the IT services and computer business in Japan. The company supplies a range of office PC and provides implementation plan and support, equipment procurement, operational support, and collect services. It also designs, installs, and configures various servers, installs and configures client PC, builds network, and performs kitting works; and provides IT infrastructure installation and configuration services and other construction work. The company sells, installs, and maintains communication, office, and office automation equipment; plans, develops, and sells software; and provides information processing services. In addition, the company is involved in the planning and production of websites; content management system development; designs and produces company brochures, pamphlets, posters, business cards, and various promotional tools; internet mail ordering business; and network construction, system maintenance, and digital content production services. The company operates Sasumaru that provides an ordering and contract management platform for SaaS products, mainly Microsoft 365 and ZOOM; HYPER FACTORY, an online store that handles business-use products, including printers, multifunction devices, and uninterruptible power supplies; a security platform under the Securitya brand; and media outlets, such as HYPER Voice that provides information on corporate IT trends and solutions to problems, and Cloud Infobox for work style reform and cloud services information that are useful for management, as well as operates the Askul Agent business, a mail-order business platform. In addition, it offers maintenance and IT consulting services, as well as specialized services comprising software development, maintenance, implementation, and operation. Further, the company sells office supplies, office furniture, etc. HYPER Inc. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

business_summary: HYPER Inc. engaged in the IT services and computer business in Japan. The company supplies a range of office PC and provides implementation plan and support, equipment procurement, operational support, and collect services. It also designs, installs, and configures various servers, installs and configures client PC, builds network, and performs kitting works; and provides IT infrastructure installation and configuration services and other construction work. The company sells, installs, and maintains communication, office, and office automation equipment; plans, develops, and sells software; and provides information processing services. In addition, the company is involved in the planning and production of websites; content management system development; designs and produces company brochures, pamphlets, posters, business cards, and various promotional tools; internet mail ordering business; and network construction, system maintenance, and digital content production services. The company operates Sasumaru that provides an ordering and contract management platform for SaaS products, mainly Microsoft 365 and ZOOM; HYPER FACTORY, an online store that handles business-use products, including printers, multifunction devices, and uninterruptible power supplies; a security platform under the Securitya brand; and media outlets, such as HYPER Voice that provides information on corporate IT trends and solutions to problems, and Cloud Infobox for work style reform and cloud services information that are useful for management, as well as operates the Askul Agent business, a mail-order business platform. In addition, it offers maintenance and IT consulting services, as well as specialized services comprising software development, maintenance, implementation, and operation. Further, the company sells office supplies, office furniture, etc. HYPER Inc. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

business_summary: j-Group Holdings Corp., together with its subsidiaries, operates restaurants in Japan. It operates through Food and Beverage Business, Real Estate Business, and Others segments. The company operates izakayas, food courts, driver's corners, and cafes; and shopping corners that sell souvenirs. It also provides development, operation, rental, and management and administration services for real estate properties. In addition, the company engages in bridal; wholesale of food products; and personnel dispatching and temporary staffing activities. The company was formerly known as j-Project Corp. and changed its name to j-Group Holdings Corp. in September 2012. j-Group Holdings Corp. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

business_summary: MonotaRO Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates an online MRO products store for factories in Japan and internationally. It offers safety protective equipment, work clothes, and safety shoes; logistics, storage, and packing supplies; tapes; safety, disaster prevention, and crime prevention products; safety signs; office supplies; office furniture/lighting/cleaning supplies; cutting tools and abrasives; measurement and surveying equipment; work tools/electric and pneumatic tools; sprays, oils, greases, and paints; adhesives and repair materials; welding supplies; and plumbing, plumbing members, pumps, pneumatics, hydraulic equipment, and hoses. It also provides mechanical parts; control equipment; soldering/static countermeasure products; building hardware and materials; painting and interior supplies; air conditioning and electrical equipment; electrical materials; screws, bolts, nails, and materials; automotive, truck, motorcycle, and bicycle supplies; scientific research and development supplies; clean room supplies; kitchen equipment and store supplies; agricultural materials and gardening supplies; and medical and nursing care supplies. The company was formerly known as Sumisho Grainger Co., Ltd. and changed its name to MonotaRO Co., Ltd. in February 2006. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan. MonotaRO Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Grainger Global Holdings, Inc.

business_summary: Jelly Beans Group Co., Ltd. plans, develops, wholesales, and retails non-leather women's footwear in Japan. It offers its products primarily under the JELLYBEANS brand. It also imports and exports women's shoes. In addition, the company engages in the import, export, wholesale, and retail of food products. Further, it engages in the freight forwarding; warehousing and warehouse management; outsourcing of reception and administrative services for hospitals and clinics; waste management, recycling, and energy utilization; Training and management of entertaining talent; Import and sale of sporting goods; artist management, and event promotion; development, manufacturing, and sales of cosmetics. The company also operates online shops. The company was formerly known as Amagasa Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JELLY BEANS GROUP Co., Ltd. in September 2024. Jelly Beans Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Jelly Beans Group Co., Ltd. plans, develops, wholesales, and retails non-leather women's footwear in Japan. It offers its products primarily under the JELLYBEANS brand. It also imports and exports women's shoes. In addition, the company engages in the import, export, wholesale, and retail of food products. Further, it engages in the freight forwarding; warehousing and warehouse management; outsourcing of reception and administrative services for hospitals and clinics; waste management, recycling, and energy utilization; Training and management of entertaining talent; Import and sale of sporting goods; artist management, and event promotion; development, manufacturing, and sales of cosmetics. The company also operates online shops. The company was formerly known as Amagasa Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JELLY BEANS GROUP Co., Ltd. in September 2024. Jelly Beans Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Ai Holdings Corporation provides security and peripheral computer equipment, measuring equipment, business communication systems, and card and other office equipment. The company offers surveillance cameras and recorders for banks, governmental facilities, shopping districts, retail shops, and other facilities, as well as installation and after-sales services; card issuing system and specialized CAD software for steel structures; and systems for medical institutions to general-purpose systems, such as magnetic card readers, ID cards, and cards with embedded IC chips. The company also provides cutting plotters for professional and home use; measuring instruments for voltage, current, temperature, humidity, pulse, and data captures; cloud storage products; and office-oriented business phones for general corporate offices, nursing care facilities, medical facilities, factory plants, mass retailers, and commercial facilities, as well as an optimal communications system for small-to-large-scale business establishments. In addition, it develops, manufactures, and sells the Ai-Glies demand control and energy conservation systems, which reduce electric power consumption and power usage fees for air conditioners; and offers architectural design and mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineering services, as well as engages in the IoT promotion business, such as IoT, high-speed communications (5G/6G), digital transformations (DX), and AI-based automation. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

The company was formerly known as C'sMEN Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Star seeds Co.,Ltd. in November 2024. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

優れた品質と洗練されたデザインは、私たちのブランド価値の根幹です。最新のトレンドを踏まえながら、独自の視点で商品を開発し、お客様に新しい価値と感動を提供し続けます。 社会的責任の履行 03 企業としての社会的責任を果たすため、環境への配慮、地域社会への貢献、公正な取引を実践しています。持続可能な社会の実現に向けて、積極的に取り組んでいます。 従業員の成長と幸福の追求 04 3月 株式会社キャビンの全額出資により、同社のメンズ事業部を分離・独立させ、株式会社シーズメンを設立。 4月 川西アステ店の開店により、関西地区へ進出。 5月 長崎銅座町店を開店し、九州地区へ進出。 1990年 4月 広島アルパーク店を開店し、中国地区へ進出。 1996年 7月 初の100坪を超える店舗池袋アルパ店を開店。店舗の大型化を図る。 1997年 3月 高松店を開店。四国地区へ進出。 10月 店舗の大型化の可能性を追求するため、230坪のジョイフルタウン鳥栖店を開店。 1998年 10月 神戸、京都、大阪に４店舗を開店。関西圏を10店舗とし、同地区の基盤を強化。 1999年 11月 ファミリー対応型の大型店舗の本格展開を図り、194坪の港品川ジャスコ店を開店。 2002年 3月 大株主である株式会社キャビン保有の当社株式3,000株をジェイジェイ・プライベートエクイティ壱号投資事業有限責任組合に譲渡。 6月 ジェイジェイ・プライベートエクイティ壱号投資事業有限責任組合保有の株式の1,413株を役員及び従業員持株会等へ譲渡し、ＭＢＯ（マネージメントバイアウト）が完了。 2003年 2月 札幌ステラプレイス店を開店。北海道地区へ進出。 2006年 3月 流儀圧搾の前身となるＭＥＴＨＯＤ ＥＸＰＲＥＳＳをお台場ＤＥＣＫＳに開店。 9月 イオン大日に流儀圧搾１号店を開店。 2007年 8月 大阪証券取引所ヘラクレス（2022年４月東京証券取引所ＪＡＳＤＡＱ（スタンダード）からスタンダード市場に移行）に株式を上場。 2009年 4月 大株主であるジェイジェイ・プライベートエクイティ壱号投資事業有限責任組合が、保有の全株式1,446株を売却。 2013年 9月 1株を100株に株式分割を実施。 2017年 5月 株式会社ネクスグループを引受先とする、自己株式185,400株による第三者割当を実施。 2018年 3月 株式会社ＣＣＣＴ（現 株式会社クシムインサイト）、株式会社シークエッジ・ジャパン・ホールディングス、株式会社ネクスグループ、他個人２名を引受先とする、新株式1,025,000株による第三者割当を実施。 8月 投資事業有限責任組合デジタルアセットファンド、他13ファンドを引受先とする、新株式882,800株による第三者割当を実施。 2021年 3月 株式会社スピックインターナショナルを株式取得により子会社化。 2022年 3月 株式会社スピックインターナショナルを分割会社、当社を承継会社とする会社分割(吸収分割)を実施。 株式会社チチカカを株式取得により子会社化。 4月 東京証券取引所の市場区分の見直しにより、東京証券取引所のＪＡＳＤＡＱ（スタンダード）からスタンダード市場に移行。 2024年 11月 スターシーズ株式会社に社名変更。 2025年 1月 株式会社MF６を株式取得により子会社化。 2月 当社出資により、合同会社パワーセル・テクノロジーズ１号を設立。 6月 新設分割を実施し、第１事業部が担うセレクト衣料品等販売事業をＥｎｓｈｉｎ株式会社に、 第２事業部が担うブランド衣料品等販売事業を株式会社ＳＰＩＣに、それぞれ承継。 持株会社体制に移行。 7月 新規事業として系統用蓄電池事業を開始。 9月 当社出資により、スターシーズデジタル株式会社を設立。 2026年 3月 株式会社MF６を株式譲渡により非子会社化。 住所 〒105-0004 東京都港区新橋四丁目21番3号 新橋東急ビル8階 TEL 03-6721-5891 設立 business_summary: Star seeds Co.,Ltd. operates fashion apparel retail stores in Japan. It also provides grid-use battery storage, and GPU servers; and is involved in the energy-related business, planning and sales of apparel and fashion-related products, and procurement and sales of AI servers for data centers. The company was formerly known as C'sMEN Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Star seeds Co.,Ltd. in November 2024. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Techno Alpha Co., Ltd. operates as a trading company in Japan and internationally. The company imports semiconductor manufacturing equipment, as well as supplies equipment, such as wedge wire bonder, bond tester, vacuum reflow soldering, VPS reflow, bonding tool, the microfocus x-ray system, plasma cleaner, die bonder, flip chip bonder products. The company also sells marine machinery and filtration products, including marine cranes, life boats, and boat davits; equipment for food and chemistry to be separated and concentrated with vibrating membrane systems; and solar cell analytical instruments and X-ray inspection systems. In addition, it operates as a system integrator; supplies measurement and inspection systems; develops and produces biochemistry instruments, which include nanoLC pumps and DiNa Series products that are used in the proteomics field; and imports and exports various biochemistry devices. Further, the company provides surface mount technology equipment/materials; LabVIEW solutions; organic photo-detector, image sensor, PDV system ferroelectric material, and Silber nano ink products; automatic shoe sole cleaners, cyclone suction mats, automatic caster cleaners, and all touchless multi-biometric access systems; injection plunger tip and material packaging tear tape products; filtration products; and educational services. Additionally, it offers electronic circuit printer, topological material, cutter, EMI tester, real-time AMC monitoring system, adhesive glue, and polarizer products; chemical science products; and temperature monitoring and fiber optic photometer products, and temperature monitoring systems. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: Techno Alpha Co., Ltd. operates as a trading company in Japan and internationally. The company imports semiconductor manufacturing equipment, as well as supplies equipment, such as wedge wire bonder, bond tester, vacuum reflow soldering, VPS reflow, bonding tool, the microfocus x-ray system, plasma cleaner, die bonder, flip chip bonder products. The company also sells marine machinery and filtration products, including marine cranes, life boats, and boat davits; equipment for food and chemistry to be separated and concentrated with vibrating membrane systems; and solar cell analytical instruments and X-ray inspection systems. In addition, it operates as a system integrator; supplies measurement and inspection systems; develops and produces biochemistry instruments, which include nanoLC pumps and DiNa Series products that are used in the proteomics field; and imports and exports various biochemistry devices. Further, the company provides surface mount technology equipment/materials; LabVIEW solutions; organic photo-detector, image sensor, PDV system ferroelectric material, and Silber nano ink products; automatic shoe sole cleaners, cyclone suction mats, automatic caster cleaners, and all touchless multi-biometric access systems; injection plunger tip and material packaging tear tape products; filtration products; and educational services. Additionally, it offers electronic circuit printer, topological material, cutter, EMI tester, real-time AMC monitoring system, adhesive glue, and polarizer products; chemical science products; and temperature monitoring and fiber optic photometer products, and temperature monitoring systems. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: Ocean System Corporation engages in the supermarket, food delivery, lunch box, inn and other businesses in Japan. The company offers lunch services, such as Daily delivered lunch boxes/frozen lunch boxes, side dishes, catering, custom-made bento boxes, and hors d'oeuvres; prepared foods for convenience stores, supermarkets, and mass retailers, and corporate clients; and food delivery services. It also operates food supermarkets under the Challenger and Gyomu Super brands; and produces and manages cafeteria operation, as well as OM Channel, an e-commerce service for ordering food online. The company was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Sanjo, Japan.

business_summary: Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings Ltd. operates department stores in Southeast Asia, China, Taiwan, the United States, and internationally. It also engages in credit cards, non-life insurance agency, and life insurance solicitation businesses; direct wooden furniture business; group department store membership clubs management business; distribution and distribution solutions businesses. In addition, the company provides construction and interior/design, renovation and interior furniture, and construction management services; real estate rental services; personnel, employment, recruitment, education and training, and labor and welfare services; and information systems solutions. Further, it operates supermarket, retail, specialty shops, food select, and restaurants; foods production; wholesale, cosmetics retail business; import, wholesale, and sale of various goods, such as miscellaneous and lifestyle goods, western wine and spirits, and food products; planning, development, and sale of gifts; planning, import, and sale of novelty goods; and exports european fashion and food products. Additionally, it is involved in the sale of large screen advertising; installation, operation, and maintenance of large-screen displays and signage; provision of advertising and promotion planning, proposal, and production, as well as advertising design, production, and editing services; planning and sale of travel products and tour conducting; owns river cruise ship; and investment and development of investee activities. Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

business_summary: Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings Ltd. operates department stores in Southeast Asia, China, Taiwan, the United States, and internationally. It also engages in credit cards, non-life insurance agency, and life insurance solicitation businesses; direct wooden furniture business; group department store membership clubs management business; distribution and distribution solutions businesses. In addition, the company provides construction and interior/design, renovation and interior furniture, and construction management services; real estate rental services; personnel, employment, recruitment, education and training, and labor and welfare services; and information systems solutions. Further, it operates supermarket, retail, specialty shops, food select, and restaurants; foods production; wholesale, cosmetics retail business; import, wholesale, and sale of various goods, such as miscellaneous and lifestyle goods, western wine and spirits, and food products; planning, development, and sale of gifts; planning, import, and sale of novelty goods; and exports european fashion and food products. Additionally, it is involved in the sale of large screen advertising; installation, operation, and maintenance of large-screen displays and signage; provision of advertising and promotion planning, proposal, and production, as well as advertising design, production, and editing services; planning and sale of travel products and tour conducting; owns river cruise ship; and investment and development of investee activities. Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

business_summary: Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings Ltd. operates department stores in Southeast Asia, China, Taiwan, the United States, and internationally. It also engages in credit cards, non-life insurance agency, and life insurance solicitation businesses; direct wooden furniture business; group department store membership clubs management business; distribution and distribution solutions businesses. In addition, the company provides construction and interior/design, renovation and interior furniture, and construction management services; real estate rental services; personnel, employment, recruitment, education and training, and labor and welfare services; and information systems solutions. Further, it operates supermarket, retail, specialty shops, food select, and restaurants; foods production; wholesale, cosmetics retail business; import, wholesale, and sale of various goods, such as miscellaneous and lifestyle goods, western wine and spirits, and food products; planning, development, and sale of gifts; planning, import, and sale of novelty goods; and exports european fashion and food products. Additionally, it is involved in the sale of large screen advertising; installation, operation, and maintenance of large-screen displays and signage; provision of advertising and promotion planning, proposal, and production, as well as advertising design, production, and editing services; planning and sale of travel products and tour conducting; owns river cruise ship; and investment and development of investee activities. Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

business_summary: Toyobo Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, processes, and sells various films, life sciences, environmental and functional materials, and fibers and textiles products in Japan, China, Southeast Asia, and internationally. It operates through five segments: Film; Life Science; Environmental and Functional Materials; Functional Fibers and Trading; and Real Estate. The company offers industrial films for liquid crystal polarizers, displays, synthetic paper, labels, and ceramic capacitors; and packaging films for food packaging and other products. It also provides hollow fiber membranes for artificial kidneys and food, beverage, and industrial membranes; antithrombogenic polymers, nerve regeneration guidance conduits, and bone void fillers with collagen; contract manufacturing of injections, contract packaging, and contract testing; enzymes for diagnostic reagent, reagents for life science research, and IVD devices and reagents; and cosmetics ingredients. In addition, the company offers engineering plastics and elastomer; filter materials, equipment and device systems, and bag filters; reverse osmosis membrane modules; cushion materials for seatings, mattresses, and bedclothes; recycled polyester staple fibers and polyester spunbonds; polyethylene and PBO fibers; industrial adhesives and coatings, as well as water-wash letterpress plates; and fine chemicals and pharmaceutical intermediates. Further, it is involved in the provision of industrial fibers and civil materials, comfort evaluation technology, airbag fabrics, adhesives and coating materials, and clothing fiber functional materials; and rental and management of real estate properties. The company was founded in 1882 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

business_summary: Unitika Ltd. manufactures and sells polymers, performance materials, industrial fibers and textiles, and others in Japan and internationally. The company offers polymers, such as nylon and polyester films; nylon, polyester, and polyarylate plastic products; polyester, nylon spunbonded, and cotton spunlace nonwoven fabrics; and biodegradable plastic materials. In addition, the company offers fibers and textiles, such as garments, lifestyle materials, and bedding products, as well as terramac fibers. Unitika Ltd. was incorporated in 1889 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Fujibo Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells polishing pads, industrial chemical products, and apparel products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three Abrasives Business, Chemical Industrial Products Business, and Life Clothing Business segments. It provides POLYPAS polishing pads for precision polishing of silicon wafers, as well as for various types of semiconductor materials, metals, and glasses; fine chemical intermediates, spinning, textiles and apparel; and functional non-woven fabrics, functional films, non-woven polyester fabrics and artificial leathers. The company offers organic synthesis intermediates to produce raw materials for medicines, agricultural chemicals, electronic materials, and functional chemicals; and functional fibers, spun yarns, and knitted fabrics. In addition, it is involved in the business of injection molding of digital cameras, medical equipment, and automobile parts. Fujibo Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1896 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Nisshinbo Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in wireless communication, microdevice, automobile brakes, mechatronics, chemicals, textiles, and real estate businesses in China and internationally. It offers disaster prevention, monitoring, video, automotive radar, and broadcasting systems; wireless communication equipment for ships; communication and sensor equipment for transportation infrastructure; bridge system for merchant shipping; close-proximity wireless solutions; ultrasonic-related devices; and equipment for the ministry of defense. The company also provides analog, small, low-power power, and single processing semiconductors, power management IC, RF and opto-semiconductor devices, and microwave electron tubes transmitter/receiver for satellite communications products; friction materials for automobile brakes; and fans for air conditioning equipment, peripheral products for automobile headlamps, and precision parts for electronically controlled brake systems. In addition, it provides insulation materials, resin modifiers, carbon separators for fuel cells, and molding and EBS valve block products; carbon products for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, airlite foam, carbodilite resin additive, bipolar plates for fuel cells, and amorphous carbon; and wrinkle-resistant shirts and uniforms, spandex, Oikos non-woven fabrics, and elastomer-related products. Further, it sells and leases real estates, including shopping centers, sport and leisure facilities, offices, housing, and housing exhibition sites. The company was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

business_summary: Nisshinbo Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in wireless communication, microdevice, automobile brakes, mechatronics, chemicals, textiles, and real estate businesses in China and internationally. It offers disaster prevention, monitoring, video, automotive radar, and broadcasting systems; wireless communication equipment for ships; communication and sensor equipment for transportation infrastructure; bridge system for merchant shipping; close-proximity wireless solutions; ultrasonic-related devices; and equipment for the ministry of defense. The company also provides analog, small, low-power power, and single processing semiconductors, power management IC, RF and opto-semiconductor devices, and microwave electron tubes transmitter/receiver for satellite communications products; friction materials for automobile brakes; and fans for air conditioning equipment, peripheral products for automobile headlamps, and precision parts for electronically controlled brake systems. In addition, it provides insulation materials, resin modifiers, carbon separators for fuel cells, and molding and EBS valve block products; carbon products for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, airlite foam, carbodilite resin additive, bipolar plates for fuel cells, and amorphous carbon; and wrinkle-resistant shirts and uniforms, spandex, Oikos non-woven fabrics, and elastomer-related products. Further, it sells and leases real estates, including shopping centers, sport and leisure facilities, offices, housing, and housing exhibition sites. The company was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

business_summary: Nisshinbo Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in wireless communication, microdevice, automobile brakes, mechatronics, chemicals, textiles, and real estate businesses in China and internationally. It offers disaster prevention, monitoring, video, automotive radar, and broadcasting systems; wireless communication equipment for ships; communication and sensor equipment for transportation infrastructure; bridge system for merchant shipping; close-proximity wireless solutions; ultrasonic-related devices; and equipment for the ministry of defense. The company also provides analog, small, low-power power, and single processing semiconductors, power management IC, RF and opto-semiconductor devices, and microwave electron tubes transmitter/receiver for satellite communications products; friction materials for automobile brakes; and fans for air conditioning equipment, peripheral products for automobile headlamps, and precision parts for electronically controlled brake systems. In addition, it provides insulation materials, resin modifiers, carbon separators for fuel cells, and molding and EBS valve block products; carbon products for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, airlite foam, carbodilite resin additive, bipolar plates for fuel cells, and amorphous carbon; and wrinkle-resistant shirts and uniforms, spandex, Oikos non-woven fabrics, and elastomer-related products. Further, it sells and leases real estates, including shopping centers, sport and leisure facilities, offices, housing, and housing exhibition sites. The company was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

business_summary: Nisshinbo Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in wireless communication, microdevice, automobile brakes, mechatronics, chemicals, textiles, and real estate businesses in China and internationally. It offers disaster prevention, monitoring, video, automotive radar, and broadcasting systems; wireless communication equipment for ships; communication and sensor equipment for transportation infrastructure; bridge system for merchant shipping; close-proximity wireless solutions; ultrasonic-related devices; and equipment for the ministry of defense. The company also provides analog, small, low-power power, and single processing semiconductors, power management IC, RF and opto-semiconductor devices, and microwave electron tubes transmitter/receiver for satellite communications products; friction materials for automobile brakes; and fans for air conditioning equipment, peripheral products for automobile headlamps, and precision parts for electronically controlled brake systems. In addition, it provides insulation materials, resin modifiers, carbon separators for fuel cells, and molding and EBS valve block products; carbon products for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, airlite foam, carbodilite resin additive, bipolar plates for fuel cells, and amorphous carbon; and wrinkle-resistant shirts and uniforms, spandex, Oikos non-woven fabrics, and elastomer-related products. Further, it sells and leases real estates, including shopping centers, sport and leisure facilities, offices, housing, and housing exhibition sites. The company was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

business_summary: Kurabo Industries Ltd. engages in textile, chemical, technology, food and service, and real estate businesses in Japan and internationally. It manufactures and sells threads and sewn products, including yarns, fabrics; flame-retardant material and anti-static fabric; insulated clothing and bedding; yarn materials for towels/socks/underwear; work environment support tools, including on-site risk management system and assistive suit; and other products. The company manufactures, processes, and sells polyurethane foam, functional resin products, housing insulation and construction materials, nonwoven fabrics, semiconductor-related products, reinforcing fabrics, and functional materials. In addition, the company manufactures, sells, and maintains electronics-related products; designs, manufactures, constructs, and sells environmental and energy-related plants; generates biomass power using biomass power plants and livestock waste treatment system; and manufactures and sells biomedical and machine tools. Additionally, it manufactures and sells freeze-dried food; engages in the management of hotel, driving school, etc.; and engages in real estate development, management, and leases real estate properties. Kurabo Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1888 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Kurabo Industries Ltd. engages in textile, chemical, technology, food and service, and real estate businesses in Japan and internationally. It manufactures and sells threads and sewn products, including yarns, fabrics; flame-retardant material and anti-static fabric; insulated clothing and bedding; yarn materials for towels/socks/underwear; work environment support tools, including on-site risk management system and assistive suit; and other products. The company manufactures, processes, and sells polyurethane foam, functional resin products, housing insulation and construction materials, nonwoven fabrics, semiconductor-related products, reinforcing fabrics, and functional materials. In addition, the company manufactures, sells, and maintains electronics-related products; designs, manufactures, constructs, and sells environmental and energy-related plants; generates biomass power using biomass power plants and livestock waste treatment system; and manufactures and sells biomedical and machine tools. Additionally, it manufactures and sells freeze-dried food; engages in the management of hotel, driving school, etc.; and engages in real estate development, management, and leases real estate properties. Kurabo Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1888 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Kurabo Industries Ltd. engages in textile, chemical, technology, food and service, and real estate businesses in Japan and internationally. It manufactures and sells threads and sewn products, including yarns, fabrics; flame-retardant material and anti-static fabric; insulated clothing and bedding; yarn materials for towels/socks/underwear; work environment support tools, including on-site risk management system and assistive suit; and other products. The company manufactures, processes, and sells polyurethane foam, functional resin products, housing insulation and construction materials, nonwoven fabrics, semiconductor-related products, reinforcing fabrics, and functional materials. In addition, the company manufactures, sells, and maintains electronics-related products; designs, manufactures, constructs, and sells environmental and energy-related plants; generates biomass power using biomass power plants and livestock waste treatment system; and manufactures and sells biomedical and machine tools. Additionally, it manufactures and sells freeze-dried food; engages in the management of hotel, driving school, etc.; and engages in real estate development, management, and leases real estate properties. Kurabo Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1888 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Kurabo Industries Ltd. engages in textile, chemical, technology, food and service, and real estate businesses in Japan and internationally. It manufactures and sells threads and sewn products, including yarns, fabrics; flame-retardant material and anti-static fabric; insulated clothing and bedding; yarn materials for towels/socks/underwear; work environment support tools, including on-site risk management system and assistive suit; and other products. The company manufactures, processes, and sells polyurethane foam, functional resin products, housing insulation and construction materials, nonwoven fabrics, semiconductor-related products, reinforcing fabrics, and functional materials. In addition, the company manufactures, sells, and maintains electronics-related products; designs, manufactures, constructs, and sells environmental and energy-related plants; generates biomass power using biomass power plants and livestock waste treatment system; and manufactures and sells biomedical and machine tools. Additionally, it manufactures and sells freeze-dried food; engages in the management of hotel, driving school, etc.; and engages in real estate development, management, and leases real estate properties. Kurabo Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1888 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

It manufactures and sells threads and sewn products, including yarns, fabrics; flame-retardant material and anti-static fabric; insulated clothing and bedding; yarn materials for towels/socks/underwear; work environment support tools, including on-site risk management system and assistive suit; and other products. The company manufactures, processes, and sells polyurethane foam, functional resin products, housing insulation and construction materials, nonwoven fabrics, semiconductor-related products, reinforcing fabrics, and functional materials. In addition, the company manufactures, sells, and maintains electronics-related products; designs, manufactures, constructs, and sells environmental and energy-related plants; generates biomass power using biomass power plants and livestock waste treatment system; and manufactures and sells biomedical and machine tools. Kurabo Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1888 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Daiwabo Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an IT infrastructure distributor in Japan. The company operates through IT Infrastructure Distribution Business and Industrial Machinery Business. It distributes computer appliances and peripheral devices; provides technical and logistics services; iDATEN, an electronic commerce business to business system; and iKAZUCHI, a subscription management portal. In addition, the company manufactures and sells machine tools, such as vertical lathes, grinding machines, and specialized machines; and cartoning machines, intermediary packaging machines, film, cardboard casers, and other automatic machinery. Further, it manufactures and sells machine parts for production equipment and casting parts. The company was founded in 1941 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Daiwabo Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an IT infrastructure distributor in Japan. It distributes computer appliances and peripheral devices; provides technical and logistics services; iDATEN, an electronic commerce business to business system; and iKAZUCHI, a subscription management portal. It distributes computer appliances and peripheral devices; provides technical and logistics services; iDATEN, an electronic commerce business to business system; and iKAZUCHI, a subscription management portal. In addition, the company manufactures and sells machine tools, such as vertical lathes, grinding machines, and specialized machines; and cartoning machines, intermediary packaging machines, film, cardboard casers, and other automatic machinery. Further, it manufactures and sells machine parts for production equipment and casting parts. The company was founded in 1941 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: UNIVA Oak Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides management support services to various businesses in Japan. It operates through Growth Support Business; Beauty and Healthcare Business; Renewable Energy Business; Digital Marketing Business; Media Business; Sports Business; Restaurant Revitalization Business; and Shared Services Business. The company offers equity finance underwriting, merger and acquisition support; designs and sells beauty and health products; and installs and sells solar power generation equipment; and provides Gyro-n, a support tool for digital marketing. It also provides radio broadcasting, events, and various content production services; manages Royal Basketball League, an urban sports 3x3 basketball professional league; online and offline payment solutions; restaurant revitalization business; undertakes backyard operations, including general affairs, human resources, accounting, and finance of companies. The company was formerly known as Oak Capital Corporation and changed its name to UNIVA Oak Holdings Limited in October 2023. UNIVA Oak Holdings Limited was founded in 1868 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: UNIVA Oak Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides management support services to various businesses in Japan. It operates through Growth Support Business; Beauty and Healthcare Business; Renewable Energy Business; Digital Marketing Business; Media Business; Sports Business; Restaurant Revitalization Business; and Shared Services Business. The company offers equity finance underwriting, merger and acquisition support; designs and sells beauty and health products; and installs and sells solar power generation equipment; and provides Gyro-n, a support tool for digital marketing. It also provides radio broadcasting, events, and various content production services; manages Royal Basketball League, an urban sports 3x3 basketball professional league; online and offline payment solutions; restaurant revitalization business; undertakes backyard operations, including general affairs, human resources, accounting, and finance of companies. The company was formerly known as Oak Capital Corporation and changed its name to UNIVA Oak Holdings Limited in October 2023. UNIVA Oak Holdings Limited was founded in 1868 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: Toyota Boshoku Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells automotive interior systems in Japan, the United States, China, Asia, Europe, Africa, and internationally. The company engages in manufacturing and sale of automotive filters and powertrain components, and other automotive components, as well as fabric products. It also provides automobile, aircraft, and railway seats. In addition, the company offers interior and exterior products, which includes door trims, headliners, floor carpets, and luggage and exterior components comprising bumpers, fender liners, and engine undercovers. Further, it provides filter products including air, oil, and cabin air filters; air induction systems and cleaners, intake manifolds, cylinder headcovers, oil mist separator, and timing chain covers; and electric powertrain related products, such as motor core constitute and fuel cell parts, separators, and ion exchangers, as well as weets. Additionally, the company offers curtain-shield airbags, straps and seatbelt webbings, and seat fabrics. Toyota Boshoku Corporation was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Kariya, Japan.

business_summary: Toyota Boshoku Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells automotive interior systems in Japan, the United States, China, Asia, Europe, Africa, and internationally. The company engages in manufacturing and sale of automotive filters and powertrain components, and other automotive components, as well as fabric products. It also provides automobile, aircraft, and railway seats. In addition, the company offers interior and exterior products, which includes door trims, headliners, floor carpets, and luggage and exterior components comprising bumpers, fender liners, and engine undercovers. Further, it provides filter products including air, oil, and cabin air filters; air induction systems and cleaners, intake manifolds, cylinder headcovers, oil mist separator, and timing chain covers; and electric powertrain related products, such as motor core constitute and fuel cell parts, separators, and ion exchangers, as well as weets. Additionally, the company offers curtain-shield airbags, straps and seatbelt webbings, and seat fabrics. Toyota Boshoku Corporation was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Kariya, Japan.

business_summary: Saibo Co., Ltd. primarily manufactures and sells textile products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Fiber, Real Estate Utilization Business, Golf Driving Range Business, Interior Construction Business segments. It offers threads and fabrics, such as rayon filament yarn, polyester yarn, blended yarn, synthetic cotton, environmentally friendly materials, and polyester fabrics; office uniforms and work clothes for air conditioning and sanitary equipment construction companies, railway companies, jewelry companies, information centers in shopping malls, and car dealerships; and disaster preparedness supplies such as indoor evacuation tents, portable beds, long-lasting food and beverages, emergency toilets, hygiene products, cold weather gear, and bedding. In addition, it involved in the rental of commercial facilities and real estate properties, building maintenance operations, as well as golf driving range operation. Further, the company engages in the automobile body repair and painting business; and wholesale and retail of sporting goods. Saibo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Kawaguchi, Japan.

Shinden Hightex Corporation was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: kaihan co.,Ltd. plans, develops, and operates restaurants in Japan. The company develops, generates, and sells electricity through renewable energy resources. It also provides consulting services on the establishment and operation of medial institution. The company was formerly known as Kaihan, Ltd. and changed its name to kaihan co.,Ltd. in October 2006. kaihan co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Nagoya, Japan.

business_summary: Medius Holdings Co., Ltd. operates in the medical care industry in Japan. The company sells medical equipment, such as syringes, gauze, other necessary medical consumables, and advanced medical systems, and provides repair, after-sales, and maintenance services for medical equipment to hospitals and other medical facilities. It is also involved in the sale and rental of nursing care and welfare equipment to hospitals, nursing care facilities, and general individuals. In addition, the company provides the solution tools necessary for medical institutions, such as SURGELANE, STORE, SPD, ASOURCE DATABASE, and meccul. The company was formerly known as Kyowa Medical Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to Medius Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2010. Medius Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Restar Corporation engages in the sale of semiconductors, electronic components, image sensors, cameras, peripheral equipment, and related products in Japan, China, South Korea, Vietnam, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through Devices Business Unit, System Business Unit, and IT&SIer Business Unit segments. The company also offers system proposals with various line card combinations; high-value-added solutions and technical support for liquid crystal systems and overseas suppliers; LSI design, development, and support; contracted reliability test services; supply chain management for electronics; and electronics manufacturing services for mounting of electronic components, modules, and other electronic devices. In addition, it engages in the proposal, design, construction, and maintenance engineering for video, audio, communications, and measurement; development and manufacture of cashless payment terminals and individual number card authentication-related devices; and operation and management services for the introduction and diffusion of renewable energy through solar power generation. Further, the company produces and sells vegetables; and provides power and system consulting services. Additionally, it is involved in software and application development; design and manufacture of industrial PCS; development and maintenance of in-house solutions; semiconductor design and testing; and other information service businesses. The company was formerly known as Restar Holdings Corporation and changed its name to Restar Corporation in January 2024. Restar Corporation was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: Restar Corporation engages in the sale of semiconductors, electronic components, image sensors, cameras, peripheral equipment, and related products in Japan, China, South Korea, Vietnam, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through Devices Business Unit, System Business Unit, and IT&SIer Business Unit segments. The company also offers system proposals with various line card combinations; high-value-added solutions and technical support for liquid crystal systems and overseas suppliers; LSI design, development, and support; contracted reliability test services; supply chain management for electronics; and electronics manufacturing services for mounting of electronic components, modules, and other electronic devices. In addition, it engages in the proposal, design, construction, and maintenance engineering for video, audio, communications, and measurement; development and manufacture of cashless payment terminals and individual number card authentication-related devices; and operation and management services for the introduction and diffusion of renewable energy through solar power generation. Further, the company produces and sells vegetables; and provides power and system consulting services. Additionally, it is involved in software and application development; design and manufacture of industrial PCS; development and maintenance of in-house solutions; semiconductor design and testing; and other information service businesses. The company was formerly known as Restar Holdings Corporation and changed its name to Restar Corporation in January 2024. Restar Corporation was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: AZEARTH Corporation manufactures and sells chemical protective garments and environmental equipment in Japan and internationally. It provides polystyrene foam for tatami matting and flooring, insulation boards, threads, edges, and machines, as well as other types of tatami materials. The company also engages in the laying and construction work on the section that lies beneath tatami. business_summary: MERF Inc. engages in the collection, processing, manufacture, and sale of various metals in Japan, South Korea, China rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Nonferrous Metals and Arts and Crafts. It recycles and sells industrial materials and metal scraps, as well as produces base metals that are used as raw materials to manufacture electrical wires and semiconductor base plates. The company also recycle, manufactures, and sells copper alloy ingots, which are used in ship propellers, faucets, valves, and various industrial machinery components; and casts and sells works of fine arts, Buddhist statues, ritual articles, and large metal structures. In addition, it is involved in the sale of non-ferrous metals and copper and copper alloy fabricated products, as well as manufacture and sale of aluminum alloys ingots. The company was formerly known as Kurotani Corporation and changed its name to MERF Inc. in January 2025. MERF Inc. was founded in 1870 and is headquartered in Imizu, Japan.

business_summary: Cominix Co.,Ltd. operates as a specialized trading company in Japan and internationally. It operates through Cutting Tools Business, Wear-Resistant Tools Business, Overseas Business, Optical Products Business, E-commerce Business, Kamogawa Manufacturing Solutions (KMS) Business, and Other Businesses segments. The Cutting Tools Business segment sells cutting tools, holding tools, measuring instruments, machining equipment, and other products. The Wear-Resistant Tools Business segment sells wear-resistant tools, such as metal fabrication tools to domestic metal fabricators. The Overseas Business segment offers cutting tools, metal fabrication tools, wear-resistant tools, mineral resources, etc. The Optical Products Business segment sells optical components, light source devices, optical fibers for inspection equipment for semiconductors, liquid crystal displays, and solar cells. The E-commerce Business segment sells cutting tools and other products through online stores. The KMS Business segment manufactures handle cutting tools, grinding wheels, and other machine tools and production goods; and operates a renovation business that provides maintenance for tools, machine tools and equipment. The Other Businesses segment manufactures and sells cutting tools and other products. Cominix Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Cominix Co.,Ltd. operates as a specialized trading company in Japan and internationally. It operates through Cutting Tools Business, Wear-Resistant Tools Business, Overseas Business, Optical Products Business, E-commerce Business, Kamogawa Manufacturing Solutions (KMS) Business, and Other Businesses segments. The Cutting Tools Business segment sells cutting tools, holding tools, measuring instruments, machining equipment, and other products. The Wear-Resistant Tools Business segment sells wear-resistant tools, such as metal fabrication tools to domestic metal fabricators. The Overseas Business segment offers cutting tools, metal fabrication tools, wear-resistant tools, mineral resources, etc. The Optical Products Business segment sells optical components, light source devices, optical fibers for inspection equipment for semiconductors, liquid crystal displays, and solar cells. The E-commerce Business segment sells cutting tools and other products through online stores. The KMS Business segment manufactures handle cutting tools, grinding wheels, and other machine tools and production goods; and operates a renovation business that provides maintenance for tools, machine tools and equipment. The Other Businesses segment manufactures and sells cutting tools and other products. Cominix Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: AP Holdings Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manages restaurants in Japan, Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, and the United States. The company operates through two segments, Sales Business, and Production and Distribution Business. The Sales Business segment engages in the food and beverage business at restaurants. The Production and Distribution Business segment distributes food and beverages, as well as produces and distributes local chicken, fish, fruits, vegetables, etc. The company was formerly known as AP Company Co., Ltd. AP Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Sanyo Trading Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the rubber, chemical, green technology, industrial products, and life science businesses in Japan and internationally. The company offers rubbers, including synthetic and silicone rubbers, thermoplastic elastomers and resins, rubber reinforcement and fillers, flame retardants, specialty rubber chemicals, and other rubber materials and machinery. It also provides chemicals, such as waxes and environmentally friendly waxes, silane coupling agents, specialty methacrylates, environmentally friendly TMP and pentaerythritol, photoinitiators, UV absorbers/photostabilizers, antioxidants, flame retardants, urethane/epoxy curing agents, carbodiimide and related products, plasticizers, HOT SBR, NBR latex, resins, pigments, extender pigments, and defoaming and dispersing agents. In addition, the company offers seat heaters, seat ventilation systems, ECUs, lumbar support systems, sensors, suspension mats, seat adjuster motors, latch release actuators, gas springs, automotive benchmarking, and vital sensing sensors; powder and biomass related equipment; and drilling, offshore survey, and offshore wind power equipment. business_summary: Sanyo Trading Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the rubber, chemical, green technology, industrial products, and life science businesses in Japan and internationally. The company offers rubbers, including synthetic and silicone rubbers, thermoplastic elastomers and resins, rubber reinforcement and fillers, flame retardants, specialty rubber chemicals, and other rubber materials and machinery. It also provides chemicals, such as waxes and environmentally friendly waxes, silane coupling agents, specialty methacrylates, environmentally friendly TMP and pentaerythritol, photoinitiators, UV absorbers/photostabilizers, antioxidants, flame retardants, urethane/epoxy curing agents, carbodiimide and related products, plasticizers, HOT SBR, NBR latex, resins, pigments, extender pigments, and defoaming and dispersing agents. In addition, the company offers seat heaters, seat ventilation systems, ECUs, lumbar support systems, sensors, suspension mats, seat adjuster motors, latch release actuators, gas springs, automotive benchmarking, and vital sensing sensors; powder and biomass related equipment; and drilling, offshore survey, and offshore wind power equipment. Further, it provides life science related, sustainable, and advanced technology related materials for use in electronics/batteries, air fresheners, pet food, and diapers; genomics/DNA and RNA experimental devices and reagents, proteomics/protein experimental devices and reagents, cell biology/cell experimental devices and reagents, organic synthesis and analytical instruments, single-cell analysis/spatial gene expression analysis, and bioinformatics data analysis. Sanyo Trading Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Sanyo Trading Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the rubber, chemical, green technology, industrial products, and life science businesses in Japan and internationally. The company offers rubbers, including synthetic and silicone rubbers, thermoplastic elastomers and resins, rubber reinforcement and fillers, flame retardants, specialty rubber chemicals, and other rubber materials and machinery. It also provides chemicals, such as waxes and environmentally friendly waxes, silane coupling agents, specialty methacrylates, environmentally friendly TMP and pentaerythritol, photoinitiators, UV absorbers/photostabilizers, antioxidants, flame retardants, urethane/epoxy curing agents, carbodiimide and related products, plasticizers, HOT SBR, NBR latex, resins, pigments, extender pigments, and defoaming and dispersing agents. In addition, the company offers seat heaters, seat ventilation systems, ECUs, lumbar support systems, sensors, suspension mats, seat adjuster motors, latch release actuators, gas springs, automotive benchmarking, and vital sensing sensors; powder and biomass related equipment; and drilling, offshore survey, and offshore wind power equipment. Further, it provides life science related, sustainable, and advanced technology related materials for use in electronics/batteries, air fresheners, pet food, and diapers; genomics/DNA and RNA experimental devices and reagents, proteomics/protein experimental devices and reagents, cell biology/cell experimental devices and reagents, organic synthesis and analytical instruments, single-cell analysis/spatial gene expression analysis, and bioinformatics data analysis. Sanyo Trading Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

モスバーガーをはじめ、多くのフランチャイズチェーン本部に加盟してフードビジネスに取り組んでいます。「トマト＆オニオン」や「モスバーガー」のようなフランチャイズ以外に、「馳走家とり壱」や「今治街中麦酒」のような独自開発の業態も展開しています。“安心、安全、美味しい”を追求し、素材だけでなく選び抜いた調味料を使用しています。 これからは、しまなみ海道の景色を借景とした宿泊施設や自社生産の野菜、ブドウ、それを原料にしたワインづくりにも挑戦していきます。 モスバーガー トマト＆オニオン 熱烈タンタン麺 一番亭 かつれつ亭 ティア自然食堂 馳走家 とり壱 デリカ・スイーツ＆ベーカリー ツムギ本店 今治街中麦酒 bake shop offrir atelier tsumugi 地方創生事業 今治市が所有する２施設の指定管理業務を2018年より開始。2020年より西予市の施設を、2021年より鬼北町の施設を運用しております。 鈍川せせらぎ交流館 玉川湖畔の里 ユートピア宇和(游の里温泉) クアテルメ宝泉坊・宝泉坊ロッジ ほわいとファーム ネイチャーホテル・ナルカワ／高月温泉 新たな事業で新たな仲間を募集しています。 内容を確認(日本仕事百貨の記事へ) Copyright 2026
